info.title: Couli rebate-platform API
info.summary: Shared HTTP contract for the app, H5, admin console and backend.
info.description:
Single source for endpoints (D17); error codes and enums live in contracts/error-codes.yaml and
contracts/enums/*.yaml. Conventions: 规划/04 §5; authoring rules: contracts/README.md.
v0.9 (CT-02a) covers the path 登录 → 搜索 → 转链跳转; the rest is added per feature.

Every business response uses the envelope `{code, msg, data, trace_id}`; `code=0` is success.
Operation extensions: `x-auth` (none | optional | login | phone | realname, 04 §5),
`x-signed` (true = X-Timestamp / X-Nonce / X-Sign required, BR-ID-09),
`x-idempotent` (true = Idempotency-Key required, 04 §6 mark I),
`x-error-codes` (business codes the operation may return besides the common ones;
meaning, client action and data shape per code in contracts/error-codes.yaml),
`x-implementation: planned` (declared ahead of its route, TECH-05; removed when the route
ships, apps/api/src/contract.test.ts enforces both ways),
`x-step-up` (the step_up_action the `X-Step-Up-Token` header must carry, 04 §5; only the four
operations of the 04 §5 step-up row: POST /v1/withdrawals → withdraw, PUT
/v1/me/payout-account → payout_account_change, POST /v1/me/phone → phone_change,
POST /v1/me/deletion → account_deletion. Such an operation is idempotent, lists the
X-Step-Up-Token parameter and the codes 10003 (token missing, expired or for another action)
and 20903 (its Idempotency-Key was abandoned through POST /v1/idempotency-keys/abandon).
When only some requests need step-up, the condition is written in the operation
description: POST /v1/me/phone needs it only for a change, not for a first binding).
`x-min-version-gate` (true | false | conditional, 04 §5 最低支持版本): on every /v1 write
operation (not on GET); true = a client of the three apps below the minimum supported
version gets 10405; false and conditional only for the operations the interface table of
BR-ID-01 细则「最低支持版本的接口层拦截」 lists, the condition written in the description.
`x-session-scopes` (array of session_scope, 04 §5 受限会话): [full, deletion_only] on the
operations of the table in BR-ID-01 细则「受限会话」 (with the condition in the description
where only some request bodies are accepted); not marked = [full].
Common codes any operation may return: 10401, 10402, 10403, 20001, 42901, 44001, 44002,
50001, 50401; with x-auth login also 10001, 10002, 10006; with Idempotency-Key also 20901,
40901. Any operation called with a bearer token may also return 10405 when it does not accept
the token's session scope (x-session-scopes); operations whose version gate is true or
conditional, and the restricted logins, list 10405 in x-error-codes.

Admin console operations live under /admin/v1 (04 §6.6; CT-02f adds auth, me/permissions and
the read-only admins list). Their `x-auth` takes enum admin_auth_level: none (the login
steps; the intermediate `login_ticket` goes in the request body), admin (admin_token) or
super (admin_token of a super admin). After login every request carries
`Authorization: Bearer <admin_token>` (security scheme adminBearerAuth); the token is never a
cookie, so there is no CSRF token. Admin step-up tokens go in the `X-Step-Up-Token` header.
They are not app requests: no X-App-Id / X-Platform / X-Device-Id, no request signature, no
version gate, no session scopes; lists page with `page` and `page_size` ≤ 200. Common codes
of every admin operation: 10403 (data.reason=admin_ip_not_allowed), 20001, 42901, 50001;
with admin or super also 10001 and 10403 (data.reason=admin_permission_denied). An operation
guarded by a permission point (enum admin_permission) names it in its description
(「Permission point `<key>`」); console writes use CAS where state is replaced (20902 with
data.resource) and, except the original-route refund, carry no Idempotency-Key (04 §6.6).

get.summary: Liveness probe
get.description:
Returns 200 as soon as the process has finished initialising. It checks no
dependency (database, cache, queue). Served by every HTTP entry.

post.summary: Register a device
post.description:
Issues `device_id` and `install_secret` after the user has agreed to the privacy policy
(BR-ID-09). The client stores install_secret only in Keychain / Keystore / HUKS and signs
later requests with it. Not signed: the device has no secret yet.
`device_hash` is lowercase_hex(SHA-256(UTF-8 bytes of the identifier with surrounding
whitespace removed, lower-cased)) and `id_source` names the identifier (BR-ID-09 细则
「设备标识的无效值」; MVP Android uses ANDROID_ID only). The client never hashes an invalid
identifier (empty, all zeros, wrong format). A hash of the wrong format, or one on the
invalid-hash list (config device.invalid_hashes), is 20001 with `data.fields=[device_hash]`
and no device_id is issued; the client shows nothing and reads the identifier again
instead of retrying the same value. Reaching the per-IP hourly registration limit is 42901
with Retry-After (BR-ID-05 细则「发码与设备注册的风控默认值」).
`id_source` is required (04 §6.1, §3.2 devices). Making it required is not a breaking
change: the operation is still planned (no route, no caller), and the oasdiff check leaves
planned operations out of the base contract (tools/ci/oasdiff-base.ts).
Version gate: not applied (session recovery, BR-ID-01 细则 interface table). Session scopes:
accepts deletion_only (BR-ID-01 细则「受限会话」).

post.summary: Report the push token of this device
post.description:
Writes push_tokens through the notification module. The token value and its binding are
written only when the calling session is the latest login session of this device;
otherwise the report is ignored. A token value already registered on another device row
is taken over or not according to device registration order and session creation time;
a holder row that changed hands within the conflict window is frozen and reports during
the freeze are not written (BR-ID-07 细则「推送令牌与会话」). Every case answers success.
The client reports once after each successful login with the new session. provider is a
string until the push provider is chosen (orchestrator decision D-14).

200.description: Accepted (also when the report was ignored).

post.summary: Send an SMS verification code
post.description:
Order of checks: signature 10401 / 10402 → 20001 → 44001 → 44003 → 42901 (BR-ID-05). Limits per
phone: 1 per 60 s, 5 per natural hour (+08:00), 10 per natural day (+08:00); a code is 6 digits
and valid 5 minutes.
`phone` is normalised by the server (BR-ID-05 细则「手机号规范化」); when the result is not
a mainland mobile number the answer is 20001 with `data.fields=[phone]` and
`data.reason=phone_invalid`, no SMS is sent and nothing counts towards the limits.
Version gate (conditional, the table of BR-ID-01 细则 rules): not applied when purpose=login,
or purpose=step_up with action=account_deletion; applied otherwise (purpose=bind, or step_up
without action or with another action). Session scopes: a deletion_only session is accepted
only for purpose=login and for purpose=step_up with action=account_deletion. Both conditions
follow BR-ID-01 细则, which wins on any difference.

200.description: The provider accepted the SMS, or its outcome is unknown (counted as sent).

post.summary: Log in (or register) with an SMS code
post.description:
Creates the account on first login. The request carries the legal versions the user
agreed to and the time of agreement (BR-ID-04). An `invite_code` is ignored for an
existing account; `invite_bind` is present only when a non-empty invite_code was sent
(BR-INV-06). Errors: 20002 wrong code, 20003 expired code (BR-ID-05). `phone` is
normalised by the server; a number that does not normalise to a mainland mobile number is
20001 with `data.fields=[phone]`, `data.reason=phone_invalid` (BR-ID-05 细则「手机号规范化」).
Creating the account checks the same-device registration limit (44001, BR-ID-05).
Version gate: not applied (session recovery). A client below the minimum version gets a
restricted login (BR-ID-01 细则「受限会话」): only an existing account is logged in, invite_code is
ignored (BR-INV-06 handling for an existing account), nothing is created or bound, and no
existing account → 10405 with data.reason=no_account; the response carries
session_scope=deletion_only. Session scopes: accepts deletion_only.

post.summary: Get a one-time third-party authorization attempt
post.description:
Called before every WeChat, Apple or Huawei authorization (BR-ID-04 细则「第三方身份只信
服务端换取或验签的结果」). The attempt is bound to the provider, the purpose and this
device_id (purpose=step_up also to the user and `action`); it is valid once and for the
configured lifetime (auth.oauth_attempt_ttl_sec). A submission checks it first and
consumes it only after every check passed. The client passes `nonce` to the provider SDK.
purpose=step_up requires a logged-in user (otherwise 10001) and `action`; it is issued only
to an account without a bound phone (a bound phone → 20001 with `data.fields=[provider]`,
BR-ID-08). purpose=step_up with action=account_deletion is inside the 10006 whitelist
(BR-ID-31). purpose=payout_bind (WeChat only, no `action`) is the payout authorization of
BR-ID-04 细则「收款授权」 and BR-WDR-33 ②: it requires a logged-in user (otherwise 10001)
and is bound to the user, this device_id and this app's WeChat AppID; the openid it yields
is only stored on the payout account — it creates no account, writes no third-party login
binding and issues or refreshes no token. It is consumed by the payout account save, not by
a login or step-up submission. Storage unavailable → 50001.
Version gate (conditional): not applied when purpose=login, or purpose=step_up with
action=account_deletion; applied otherwise. Session scopes: a deletion_only session is
accepted only for purpose=login and for purpose=step_up with action=account_deletion. Both
per BR-ID-01 细则, which wins on any difference.

post.summary: Log in (or register) with WeChat
post.description:
Besides the fields every login carries, the body takes only `attempt_id` and the
authorization `code`; any other field (union_id, open_id, nickname, avatar, phone…) is
20001 and no account is created. The identity is what the server obtains with the code,
which is valid once (BR-ID-04 细则). A code or attempt that is invalid, expired, used or does
not match is 20004 (reasons are not told apart); the provider being unavailable, or its
answer lacking the unionid, is 50305 with `data.provider`. A first login creates the account
and checks the same-device registration limit (44001, BR-ID-05). Restricted login for clients
below the minimum version (10405) is added by CT-17a.
Version gate: not applied (session recovery). A client below the minimum version gets a
restricted login: only an account already bound to this identity is logged in, none → 10405
with data.reason=no_account, no account is created (BR-ID-01 细则「受限会话」). Session scopes:
accepts deletion_only.

post.summary: Log in (or register) with Sign in with Apple
post.description:
Besides the fields every login carries, the body takes only `attempt_id`,
`identity_token` and `authorization_code`; no client nonce. The identity is the one in the
identity token the server obtains by exchanging the authorization code, verified for
signature, iss, aud, exp and the attempt's nonce; the submitted identity_token is checked
the same way and its subject must equal that one, otherwise 20004 (BR-ID-04 细则). Otherwise
as WeChat login.
Version gate: not applied (session recovery); restricted login below the minimum version as
for WeChat login (10405 data.reason=no_account). Session scopes: accepts deletion_only.

post.summary: Log in (or register) with a Huawei account
post.description:
Phase M-公开. Besides the fields every login carries, the body takes only `attempt_id` and
`authorization_code`; otherwise as WeChat login (BR-ID-04 细则). Whether Huawei supports
PKCE or returns the nonce is still to be checked (specs/oauth/huawei.md, CT-15i); no field
for it is declared until then.
Version gate: not applied (session recovery); restricted login below the minimum version as
for WeChat login (10405 data.reason=no_account). Session scopes: accepts deletion_only.

post.summary: Merge the third-party account into the phone account
post.description:
Merges the current third-party account without phone into the account that owns the phone
number (BR-ID-06, 拍板第二批 OPS-04). The body takes only `merge_ticket`: data.merge_ticket
of the 30411 returned by POST /v1/me/phone, valid for 5 minutes and once, bound to the
current user and the target number; the SMS code was already used there and none is sent
again. On success the third-party identities move to the phone account, the source account
is tombstoned and all its sessions are revoked, and the tokens of the phone account are
returned (is_new_user=false, session_scope decided for this request as for a login). A
ticket that is expired, used or whose conditions no longer hold is only 30411; the ticket
store being unavailable is 50001 and nothing is merged. A retry with the same
Idempotency-Key after a lost response finds the source session revoked and gets 10002: the
token check comes before the idempotent replay (BR-ID-06 细则). Version gate: applied.

200.description: Merged; the tokens of the phone account.

post.summary: Second verification for a sensitive operation
post.description:
Returns a step_up_token bound to `action` (BR-ID-08); the client sends it as the
X-Step-Up-Token header of the matching operation (04 §5 step-up row). Exactly one way:
an SMS code (`action`, `code`; only for an account with a bound phone; 20002 wrong code,
20003 expired), or a new third-party authorization (`action`, `provider`, `attempt_id` and
the credential fields of that provider's login: WeChat `code`, Apple `identity_token` and
`authorization_code`, Huawei `authorization_code`), which is open only to an account
without a bound phone (a bound phone → 20001). The server checks the credential as at
login and accepts only an attempt with purpose=step_up and the same user and action; an
identity other than the one this account bound for that provider is 20004 with
`data.reason=identity_mismatch`, an invalid credential or attempt is 20004, the provider
being unavailable is 50305.
Version gate (conditional): not applied when action=account_deletion; applied otherwise.
Session scopes: a deletion_only session is accepted only for action=account_deletion. Both
per BR-ID-01 细则, which wins on any difference.

wechat.summary: WeChat re-authorization (account without a bound phone)

200.description: A step-up token for the action.

post.summary: Rotate the token pair
post.description:
Every refresh rotates the refresh token (BR-ID-07). Resubmitting a rotated token outside
the 30-second grace revokes the whole session chain and returns 10404. Clients refresh
single-flight: N concurrent 10002 trigger one refresh.
Version gate: not applied (session recovery). The scope of the refreshed session is decided
again from this request (X-Platform, X-Channel, X-App-Version), not inherited; the session
chain (sid) is unchanged (BR-ID-01 细则「受限会话」). Session scopes: accepts deletion_only.

post.summary: Sign out on this device
post.description:
Revokes the session of the access token (its sid and the refresh tokens of that chain,
BR-ID-07) and removes the binding between this device's push token and the user
(拍板第二批 OPS-21; push_tokens is written by the notification module). Other devices of the
same user are not affected. Repeating the call with a token whose session is already
revoked is answered like any revoked token (10002 / 10404 per BR-ID-07), nothing is written.
Version gate: not applied (退出登录). Session scopes: accepts deletion_only (BR-ID-01 细则
「受限会话」).

post.summary: Record a consent or its withdrawal
post.description:
Inserts one consent_records row (insert only, BR-ID-12). Login is not required (04 §6.1
鉴权 none): with a valid access token the row is user level (user_id and this device_id);
without one it is device level (device_id from X-Device-Id, user_id empty). A device
without a registered device_id cannot record (BR-ID-12: the first-launch consent is kept
locally and reported right after device registration). The current state of a subject and
type is the row with the latest server_at; server_at is the server clock, client_at is the
tap time on the device. Withdrawing the privacy consent (type=privacy, accepted=false, the
privacy center 【撤回同意】) is always a device-level row even with a token: subject is this
device, user_id is kept only as an association, other devices' user-level state is not
changed; the server then revokes this device's sessions and install_secret and clears its
push token, and the client enters basic mode (BR-ID-13). Other withdrawals (for example
ai_third_party, BR-AI-13) follow the user / device rule above.
type=clipboard_auto_import (the purpose consent for clipboard auto-recognition, BR-ID-16)
is likewise always a device-level row, with or without a token and for accepted true or
false: subject is this device, user_id is kept only as an association, other devices'
state is not changed (the same subject rule as withdrawing the privacy consent, BR-ID-12
细则); it never takes part in login_merge. Its `version` is the string
config.clipboard.consent_version; every other type takes a positive integer version. A
type and version form that do not pair → 20001 with data.fields=[version]. A
clipboard_auto_import request must carry the device signature: the operation stays
x-signed false because the other types are not signed, and the server checks the
signature headers (X-Timestamp, X-Nonce, X-Sign, same rules as the signing guard) inside
the handler for this type only; a missing or invalid signature → 10401, a device that is
not registered, revoked or not server-issued → 10402, the same codes as the signing guard.
`type` never takes labor_agreement (signed only through the labor agreement endpoint,
BR-WDR-31). `channel` never takes login_merge, h5_landing or withdraw_flow: those rows are
written by the server (login merge, landing registration, labor agreement signing).
A field outside these values → 20001 with data.fields.
Version gate (conditional): not applied to accepted=false of any type, nor to type privacy
or agreement; applied otherwise. Session scopes: a deletion_only session is accepted only
for the same requests (any withdrawal, and privacy or agreement records). Both per BR-ID-01
细则, which wins on any difference.

clipboard_auto_import.summary: Clipboard auto-recognition purpose consent (string version, signed)

post.summary: Exchange the native session for an h5_token
post.description:
The native app gets an h5_token (aud=h5) for its trusted H5 pages; lifetime and scope per
BR-ID-32. A read_only token calling anything but GET is 10403 with
data.reason=h5_read_only, decided by the server from the HTTP method. Version gate:
applied (BR-ID-01 细则 interface table). Session scopes: not marked, so a deletion_only
session gets 10405.

get.summary: Authorization state per platform
get.description:
One item per platform. A platform with an unreleased binding gives that binding's status;
otherwise released when a released binding exists, otherwise unbound. Pinduoduo reports
the authorization of the self-purchase promotion slot. No released_at, cooldown_until,
account name, nickname or avatar (BR-ID-17 细则「授权方式」「授权管理页」; how the page
shows each status is in BR-ID-17 细则).

get.summary: Get the authorization link of a platform
get.description:
Returns auth_url, state and the ordered auth_methods (Taobao: configured per platform of
the device record; the client uses the first one it can run, BR-ID-17 细则「授权方式」).
For platform=pdd the response carries auth_jump instead of auth_methods (executed like a
purchase jump plan, h5 steps in the system browser, no link_jump report). No self-service
rebinding or unbinding. A blocked binding of a user who is not banned is 30153 and no
auth_url is issued (BR-ID-17 细则「授权管理页」). For platform=taobao, while the site's own
union authorization is unavailable the request gets the same code as a purchase would
(30101 for unbound, pending_auth or released, 30102 for invalid) with
data.reason=auth_unavailable and no auth_url; the client only shows the notice. Pinduoduo
answers 50301 with data.reason=maintenance and no auth_url (BR-ID-24 ④).

parameters.name: installed
parameters.description: Whether the platform app is installed; when absent see BR-ID-22 细则.

pdd.summary: Pinduoduo, with an authorization jump plan

post.summary: Bind after the user authorized
post.description:
Taobao body: exactly one of {state, auth_method: web_code, code} and
{state, auth_method: sdk_token, access_token, expires_in}; no nickname, avatar or account
name, and any undefined field is 20001. The server checks first and consumes later: uid,
device_id, the platform of the device record (X-Platform is only a claim) and the issued
method must all match before the state is marked used; then the configured app exchanges
or uses the credential. A method that was not issued, is closed or does not match the
device is 30104 with data.reason=method_not_allowed (the state stays unused); an invalid
credential, or one the upstream says is not for this app, is 30104 with
data.reason=credential_invalid; an expired or used state is 30104 without reason. Every
binding attempt (new state or new credential) uses a new Idempotency-Key; only a transport
retry of the same request keeps it (BR-ID-17 细则「授权方式」). While the site's own union
authorization is unavailable the request gets 30101 (unbound, pending_auth or released) or
30102 (invalid) with data.reason=auth_unavailable and no auth_url (BR-ID-24 ④).

get.summary: My orders (self-purchase or shared)
get.description:
Orders of the current account in the visible range, newest paid first. scope=self gives the
full order_no (copyable); scope=share gives only masked_order_no, and an item whose bought
product is not the shared one (is_other_product=true) has title and image_url null — both
trimmed by the server. Shared orders exclude referral-commission orders. status_group
groups display_status on the server; q matches a self-purchase order by its exact parent or
child order number, otherwise titles; shared orders are matched by the visible title only.
Grouping, search and projection rules are only in BR-TEXT-02 细则「订单列表的状态分组与查找」
「订单的检索范围与分享单的投影」. earliest_visible_date is the first day in range
(null when unlimited; BR-ID-30 细则「订单类记录」). For a pre-sale order in DEPOSIT_PAID,
pay_amount_fen is the deposit paid, null when the platform does not report it
(BR-TEXT-02 细则「预售单的付款金额」, wording pending CAP-*-07).

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: self = my own purchases; share = orders bought through my shares.

parameters.name: status_group
parameters.description: Status group (enum order_status_group); absent = all.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Order number or title words, at most 40 characters (BR-TEXT-02 细则).

parameters.name: paid_month
parameters.description: Month of payment, YYYY-MM in +08:00; only months in the visible range.

post.summary: Submit an order claim
post.description:
Claims an order that was not attributed to the current account (BR-ATTR-17). The H5 form
calls it through the bridge `net.signedRequest`, which signs it (bridge signed_paths). The
check order and every error code, including 30202 and 30203 `data.reason`, are only in
BR-ATTR-17 and BR-ATTR-19: 30203 without data is the daily limit of created claims,
30203 with data.reason=RISK_BLOCKED is the risk block. Orders are matched only in the app of
the token. A shared order is treated as not existing: it never enters the claim, and the
response is the same 30201 (same HTTP status, msg and no data) as an unknown order number.
When no child order passes, the error of the first child order by sub_order_id ascending is
returned. For pdd the hyphens are removed from both the input and the stored order numbers
before comparing. The 200 response carries only the claim that was created, whose items are
the child orders that passed; acceptance and the evidence computation (BR-ATTR-18) share one
transaction, so status is auto_matched or manual_review. Version gate: applied.

get.summary: My order claims
get.description:
The claims of the current account only (app_id and user_id of the token), newest created
first, each with its child orders, their decision (null while pending) and reject reason
(BR-ATTR-17, BR-ATTR-18). Shared orders never appear: they were removed when the claim was
accepted.

get.summary: Pending-track cards
get.description:
One card per platform at most, chosen per open attempt (link_open_attempts): attempts with
a jump report first, the latest open wins; jumped_at is that attempt's open time; whether a
card shows, disappears or offers the claim entry is decided by the server (BR-ATTR-21 细则
「待跟单卡按实际外跳选」「待跟单卡的完成与关闭按尝试」). dismissed tells whether the user
closed this attempt's card.

post.summary: Close a pending-track card
post.description:
Closes only the attempt named in the body (link_open_attempts.dismissed_at, written once);
other attempts of the same link are untouched. Repeating the call is harmless (no
Idempotency-Key). A missing attempt_id, or one that is not the current user's or not of
the link in the path, is 20001 with data.fields=[attempt_id] and nothing is written
(BR-ATTR-21 细则「待跟单卡的完成与关闭按尝试」). Version gate: applied.

200.description: The card of this attempt is closed.

get.summary: Order detail
get.description:
Same projection as the list (scope by order ownership): full order_no for my own purchase,
masked_order_no for a shared order; is_other_product=true trims title, image_url and
product_key. product_key is set only for my own purchase and a shared order with
is_other_product=false. timeline lists the nodes of BR-TEXT-02 细则「时间线」 (a pre-sale
order starts with deposit_paid); a node that has not happened has at null. reason and
reason_action explain a missing rebate directly, without AI (拍板第二批 AI-09). An order
outside the visible range, not the user's, or unknown is 30701 (BR-ID-30 细则).

get.summary: Current privacy policy and user agreement
get.description:
The currently effective version of the privacy policy and of the user agreement (04 §6.2
agreements; the versions match legal.privacy.version and legal.agreement.version of GET
/v1/config). Each carries `min_version` (re-consent starts below it, BR-ID-12), the
article holding its text (`article_id`, `article_version`, readable with GET
/v1/articles/{article_id}?version=), the lower-case hex sha256 of that text, the address of
the full text and when it was published. A type never published is null. The labor
agreement is not listed here; it is read with GET /v1/me/labor-agreement (BR-WDR-31).
Readable anonymously in basic mode, without a device id (BR-ID-11 细则).

200.description: The current privacy policy and user agreement.

get.summary: Help, rules, notices and agreements
get.description:
Published articles of one category, each at its current published version (the version field;
an older version is read with GET /v1/articles/{article_id}?version=). Items of the notice
category also carry
`notice` (NoticeItem); only items whose notice is in its effective window are returned, with
start_at = published_at, end_at = notice_end_at and content_version maintained on its own
(not the article revision); filtering again by the device clock is client behaviour
(BR-TEXT-13 细则「首页公告条的关闭与内容版本」). Readable anonymously in basic mode, without
a device id (BR-ID-11 细则, pending legal confirmation). Session scopes: accepts
deletion_only (BR-ID-01 细则「受限会话」).

get.summary: One article
get.description:
Full text of a published article, the current version or the one asked for with version;
unknown or unpublished → 30701. Readable anonymously, without a device id (BR-ID-11 细则).

parameters.name: version
parameters.description:
Published version to read (articles are kept by version, 04 §6.2); without it the current
published version. An unknown or unpublished version → 30701.

get.summary: Update check for this platform and channel
get.description:
By X-Platform and X-Channel: latest, minimum supported and recommended versions, update
title and notes, store_url (default address of this platform and channel; for the Android
universal package the client first looks up the store table by install source, 03 §4.1),
default_store (the store key of store_url) and stores (in the order filled in the admin,
app_versions.store_listings; only the stores of this platform and channel, including
default_store; listed_version is the highest version users can install there, or null).
No download address of any kind (拍板第二批 TECH-19). Store choice and checks: BR-ID-01 细则
「【去更新】打开哪家商店与保存前的核对」. Called on cold start and on return to foreground
after the recheck interval; read-only and never blocked by the minimum version. Session
scopes: accepts deletion_only. No row for this platform and channel (including an absent
X-Channel) → 50001; the client treats it as a failed check (03 §4.4).

get.summary: Page configuration (home, custom:*)
get.description:
The published configuration of a page (04 §6.2; shape 03 §6.1). Only published versions
are served, never drafts (drafts are read through previewPage). Rollout (拍板第二批
OPS-05, BR-ID-11 细则): with X-Device-Id the device is bucketed and gets the gray version
when its bucket (0..9999) is below gray_percent×100; without X-Device-Id it gets the fully
released version. Sections are filtered before they are sent: the section's
min_app_version for the X-Platform of the request, compared only as 「not lower than」
X-App-Version (TECH-07, 05 F1-02), and its condition, which uses only login, has_parent,
union_authorized and has_order (03 §6.1, BR-INV-23); the bearer token is optional and
only decides those conditions. A page_key of the right shape whose page does not exist,
has no published version or has no version left for this request → 30701. `ttl_sec` is
the server constant 300 (the example value of 03 §6.1; 编排者默认, pending a write-back
to the plan). Session scopes: full only (not on the BR-ID-01 细则「受限会话」 table).

200.description: The page as this device and user see it.

get.summary: Draft page preview (test builds only)
get.description:
Read-only preview of a draft, allowed only by an admin-issued preview token (10 minutes)
and never by a user token. The token is valid only in the environment that issued it;
invalid, expired or issued elsewhere → 30701. Only the HomePreview route of test builds
calls it; release builds have no route or code for it (03 §3.6). The QR code carries only
token and page_key, no host name. sections follow contracts/home-schema.json.

get.summary: One inbox message (push-click lookup)
get.description:
Looks up where a push click goes by message id: message_id, code, title, body, created_at,
read_at and route ({route, params} or null). Only messages of the logged-in account; unknown
or someone else's → 30701 (not distinguished). Read-only: does not change read_at
(BR-ID-10 细则「推送点击的落点」).

get.summary: My inbox messages
get.description:
In-app messages of the logged-in account, newest first (created_at, then message_id, both
descending; 04 §6.4 站内消息). Each item has the same fields as GET
/v1/messages/{message_id}: message_id, code, title, body, created_at, read_at (null =
unread) and route ({route, params} or null). Listing does not change read_at.
`next_cursor` fetches the next (older) page; null means no more. A malformed or foreign
cursor is 20001 with data.fields=[cursor]. Messages are written whatever the push
settings are (GET /v1/me/notification-settings). Not signed and no Idempotency-Key: a
read of the user's own data, 04 §6 marks neither S nor I.

200.description: One page of my messages, newest first.

post.summary: Mark inbox messages as read
post.description:
The body is exactly one of two forms: `{message_ids: [...]}` (1–100 ids) marks those
messages, `{all: true}` marks every unread message of the logged-in account. Duplicate ids
are counted once; ids that do not exist or belong to someone else are skipped silently
(no error, so the call reveals nothing about other accounts' messages, as 30701 of GET
/v1/messages/{message_id} does not either). A message already read keeps its read_at.
Response: `marked_count` is how many messages this call turned from unread to read (0
when nothing was unread), `unread_count` the account's unread messages left after the
call (same value as GET /v1/messages/unread-count). A body with both or neither form, an
empty list, more than 100 ids or `all` other than true is 20001 with data.fields.
Repeating the call is harmless (idempotent by its effect: the second call marks 0), so no
Idempotency-Key is required; not signed, as 04 §6 marks neither S nor I. Version gate:
applied.

200.description: The messages are read; counts of this call and of what is left.

get.summary: Number of my unread inbox messages
get.description:
`unread_count` is the number of the logged-in account's messages with read_at null (the
badge on the message entry). Not signed and no Idempotency-Key: a read of the user's own
data, 04 §6 marks neither S nor I.

get.summary: Single-balance summary
get.description:
Values per BR-FUND-18 (field names per FUND-18). The user side shows「预估返 / 预估推广收益
¥{estimated_total_fen}」 and uses pending_credit_* only for the「其中已收货」 progress line;
the client never adds amounts itself (BR-TEXT-01). next_credit_period is the earliest
expected credit month across platforms (YYYY-MM). withdraw_enabled = withdraw.enabled
(04 §10.2): false keeps the balances visible, greys out the withdraw button and shows the
error.30306 text, the same sentence as a 30306 on submit. Session scopes: accepts
deletion_only (BR-ID-01 细则「受限会话」).

get.summary: Earnings dashboard of the current user
get.description:
Display only; the figures and their periods are defined only in BR-FUND-25 (pending owner
decision, default per 功能对照 Q-10). as_of is the time the figures were computed; periods
are +08:00 natural days and months computed by the server, the client never converts them.
self and share have today, yesterday, this_month and last_month, each {paid_count,
est_fen, credited_fen}; credited_fen is signed and may be negative in a period that has
only reversals (BR-FUND-25 细则「已结算怎样聚合」). referral has only this_month and
last_month, each {est_fen, credited_fen}, no count; null while
earnings.dashboard.referral_visible is off. The optional platform filters self and share
only; referral is always the total of all platforms. earnings.dashboard.enabled off →
30701. Terms and text keys per BR-TEXT-01.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Platform code (enum platform); filters self and share only. Absent = all.

get.summary: Balance entries
get.description:
Only available-subaccount entries plus one WITHDRAW_PAID summary entry per paid withdrawal
(BR-FUND-15); no account filter (single balance). balance_after_fen is the available balance
after the entry (may be negative); null on the WITHDRAW_PAID summary entry, which does not
change the available balance. Referral-commission entries are masked (masked=true, shown as
「邀请好友订单」, BR-TEXT-19). link_type / link_id point to the order or withdrawal, null
when not navigable. fee_fen and tax_fen only on summary entries.

get.summary: Withdrawal precheck and estimate
get.description:
can_withdraw, block_code and block_reason (check order BR-WDR-03; withdraw.enabled off →
block_code 30306; current labor agreement not signed → 10004, BR-WDR-31), the maximum
withdrawable amount, today's and this month's remaining counts, and the estimate:
withdrawable_fen (same as GET /v1/wallet/summary, BR-FUND-18), est_fee_fen, est_tax_fen,
est_net_fen (null when can_withdraw=false) and quick_amounts_fen. With amount_fen the
estimate uses that amount, otherwise max_withdrawable_fen; the estimate does not validate the
amount. The client sends the user to the page of block_code and, back on Withdraw, fetches
the rules again without submitting (BR-WDR-07 细则「前置步骤的回流」); late or out-of-order
responses are dropped by the client by account, page instance, request number and amount
(BR-WDR-04 细则「估算响应的归属」). block_reason carries data.reason of block_code 30303
(enum withdraw_condition_reason) and is null otherwise.

parameters.name: amount_fen
parameters.description: Amount to estimate; a positive integer, otherwise 20001 data.fields=[amount_fen].

get.summary: My withdrawals
get.description:
Status, review_mode (auto: the client says「预计几分钟内到账」, manual: within 24 working
hours, 拍板第二批 OPS-17), amounts, payout channel and masked account, the reason code of a
rejection or failure and fail_action for account-type failures (BR-TEXT-06, BR-TEXT-08).
channel_order_id is only in the detail.

post.summary: Apply for a withdrawal
post.description:
From the single balance (no account type in the body, ADD-06); entry and auth BR-WDR-01,
check order BR-WDR-03. Not signed the labor agreement → 10004 with
data.consent_type=labor_agreement. Stopped by a precondition the user must complete (10001,
10004 of any consent_type, 10005, 30304 / 30305 / 30307): not replayed; after completing
it the user submits again on Withdraw with a new Idempotency-Key. Only 10003, 10002 and
10402 resend with the same key. When the result is unknown the key is kept: the page waits
for the user to confirm (same key) or give up (POST /v1/idempotency-keys/abandon); an
abandoned key is 20903 at the idempotency check, without comparing the body or running the
business, and a business write that finds it abandoned is rolled back with 20903 (BR-WDR-07
细则「前置步骤的回流」, BR-ID-10 细则「敏感操作的幂等键」). Needs X-Step-Up-Token for action
withdraw. The user cannot cancel after submitting (customer service rejects with
USER_REQUEST, 拍板第二批 FUND-20); review_mode is decided after submission (BR-WDR-30).
Version gate: applied.

get.summary: One of my withdrawals
get.description:
As the list item plus channel_order_id (the channel serial number, only in PAID_API /
PAID_MANUAL when one was recorded, BR-WDR-25 细则「交易流水号」). Unknown or someone else's →
30701.

get.summary: Current user
get.description:
Nickname and default avatar, invite code, whether an inviter is bound (only yes / no),
invite_backfill (whether the invite code can still be filled in, BR-INV-07), identity level (BR-ID-01), single-balance summary, union authorization states, real-name
state, `need_reconsent` (BR-ID-12) and the risk state for the ban / freeze page. No
user level (拍板第二批 OPS-20).
Session scopes: accepts deletion_only (step-up method choice on the force-update and
deletion pages, BR-ID-01 细则「受限会话」).

patch.description:
Takes only `nickname`; the avatar cannot be changed in the MVP (BR-ID-39, 拍板第二批
OPS-13), so any other field is 20001. The nickname, trimmed of leading and trailing white
space, must be 1–16 extended grapheme clusters, otherwise 20001 with data.fields containing
nickname. It then goes through content-safety text review: a hit, or a review that times
out (fail-close), is 20001 with data.reason=nickname_sensitive and is not counted. After 3
successful changes in the natural month (+08:00) a further change is 30415. The client
fetches GET /v1/me again after success. Version gate: applied.

post.summary: Bind or change the phone number
post.description:
Binds a phone number to the account, or changes it. code is a purpose=bind SMS code sent to
the new number. Order of checks (BR-ID-06): 44001 (number blacklisted) → 30411 (number
belongs to another account of this app, including one in the deletion cooling period or
processing). Accounts are never merged here; the one exception is a third-party account
without phone that meets the BR-ID-06 merge conditions: 30411 then carries
data.reason=mergeable and data.merge_ticket and the client asks before calling
POST /v1/auth/merge (拍板第二批 OPS-04). Step-up applies to a change only: changing a bound
number needs X-Step-Up-Token for action phone_change (an SMS to the old number,
BR-ID-08); a first binding does not. With account.phone_change_enabled=false a change
(not a first binding) is 30414. Wrong or expired code: 20002 / 20003 (BR-ID-05). An
Idempotency-Key that was abandoned (POST /v1/idempotency-keys/abandon) is 20903 at the
idempotency check, without comparing the body or running the business; a business write
that finds the key abandoned is rolled back and also returns 20903 (04 §5「幂等」). The
client fetches GET /v1/me again after success. Version gate: applied.

200.description: The number is bound to the account.

post.summary: Bind an inviter by invite code (backfill, once)
post.description:
The "我的" backfill of an invite code (source backfill, BR-INV-03, BR-INV-07). The server
normalises invite_code in three steps: Unicode NFKC → remove all Unicode white space
(U+3000 included) and the zero-width characters U+200B–U+200D, U+FEFF → upper case; no
O→0 style correction (BR-INV-02). Order of checks, the first hit is returned (BR-INV-02):
10005 (no bound phone) → 30408 (growth.invite_bind.enabled off) → 42901 → 30402 (already
has an inviter or has used the self-binding chance) → 30404 (now ≥ users.created_at +
invite.backfill_hours, default 168 hours, to the second; the boundary instant itself is
rejected) → 30409 (has an order, a claim or a direct invitee, any status) → 30401
(normalised code empty, length ≠ 6 or outside the character set; no lookup) → 30401
(inviter missing or unavailable) → 30403 (self, own invitee or same device, BR-INV-08).
30401 never tells the reason. Every 30401 counts per phone_hmac per natural day
(+08:00); once the count reaches invite.fail_limit_per_day (5) the following requests that
day stop at the rate-limit step with 42901 and Retry-After up to the next 00:00 +08:00.
Succeeds at most once per account: the write is conditional (no inviter and the
self-binding chance unused), so of two concurrent requests with different keys exactly one
binds and the other gets 30402. The client fetches GET /v1/me again after success.
Version gate: applied.

get.summary: My invite code, landing link and poster
get.description:
The invite page (BR-INV-18). 10005 when no phone is bound. A user identified as under 18
(realname verified, BR-INV-19) gets 30413 with data.reason=self_minor and the client hides
the invite and share entries. Otherwise 200: when inviter_unavailable(self) is true
(BR-INV-02) can_invite=false and invite_code, landing_url and poster_url are null while
direct_count is still returned; the client shows "暂不可邀请" without a reason.
landing_url is `{a current share domain}/i/{invite_code}` and may carry a channel code
parameter; it never contains the UID, the phone number or the nickname. poster_url is the
poster image drawn by the server (04 §6.4, TECH-13); null while poster drawing is not
available.

post.summary: Send an SMS login code from the invite landing page
post.description:
Used only by the invite landing page opened outside the app (BR-ID-32, BR-INV-05); the
code is a purpose=login code (not sent in the body). No device id, no request signature
and no human verification. `phone` is normalised by the server (BR-ID-05 细则「手机号规范化」).
Order of checks: 20001 (not a mainland mobile number after normalisation:
`data.fields=[phone]`, `data.reason=phone_invalid`; no SMS, nothing counted) → 44001
(blocked number prefix or blacklisted phone) → 42901 with Retry-After (the two per-IP
limits and the per-phone limits of BR-ID-05 细则「判定位置」). Code rules as BR-ID-05:
6 digits, valid 5 minutes, a new code voids the previous one. Not signed. Version gate:
不判定：落地页 (written false, BR-ID-01 细则).

200.description: The provider accepted the SMS, or its outcome is unknown (counted as sent).

post.summary: Register on the invite landing page and bind the inviter
post.description:
The landing-page registration (source landing, BR-INV-05; the `POST /v1/landing/login` of
BR-ID-32). No device id, no request signature, no human verification; phone and invite_code
are normalised by the server (BR-ID-05 细则「手机号规范化」, BR-INV-02). Order of checks,
the first hit is returned: agreed=true, otherwise 10004 with data.consent_type=agreement →
30408 (growth.invite_bind.enabled off; no account is created) → 42901 with Retry-After (the
same IP or the same phone_hmac already has invite.fail_limit_per_day (5) 30401 today,
+08:00) → 30401 (normalised code empty, length ≠ 6 or outside the character set) → 30401
(inviter missing or unavailable) → 20002 / 20003 (the purpose=login SMS code is checked and
used up, BR-ID-05) → the phone already has an account → result=already_registered → 44001
(landing.ip_register_limit reached for the IP in the last 3600 s, BR-ID-32; no account) →
the account is created and the inviter bound in one transaction (result=registered). A
phone that is not a mainland mobile number after normalisation is 20001. An invite code
failure does not use up the SMS code. already_registered changes no relation and tells
nothing more; an account in the deletion cooling period or processing counts as
registered, a phone whose only account finished deletion counts as new. The same IP or
phone_hmac counts every 30401 (BR-INV-02). No token is issued; the page sends the user to
the app to log in with the same number. Idempotency subject `p:<phone_hmac>` (04 §5).
Not signed. Version gate: 不判定：落地页 (written false, BR-ID-01 细则).

200.description: Registered and bound, or the phone already has an account.

registered.summary: New account created and bound to the inviter

already_registered.summary: The phone already has an account; nothing changed

get.summary: My current payout account (masked)
get.description:
Only payout_method, masked_account, bank_name (bank card only), masked_payee_name and
change_remaining_this_month (changes left this natural month, BR-WDR-02 ④, never below 0);
an empty object when nothing is bound. Never the ID number, the full logon id or card
number, the card BIN or the full name; masking is done by the server (BR-ID-33 细则
「收款账号的脱敏格式」).

200.description: The current payout account, or an empty object.

put.summary: Bind or change my payout account
put.description:
Body by payout_method (withdraw.payout_methods decides which are open): alipay with the
logon id and payee_name, bank_card with card number, bank name and payee_name. payee_name
and the real name are both normalised before comparing; different → 30307 (BR-WDR-02 ①).
A bank card must be a debit card of the user: 12–19 digits with Luhn, else 20001
data.fields=[card_no]; three-element verification mismatch → 30307 (⑥). An Alipay logon id
in phone form that does not normalise is 20001 with data.reason=phone_invalid (BR-WDR-02
细则). Account held by another user → 30308; blacklisted → 44001. Changes per natural
month over the limit → 30303 data.reason=payout_account_change_limit (④); the paid
verification reserves the day's quota before calling the vendor and a full quota is 30303
data.reason=payout_account_verify_limit without a vendor call (⑦). A verification of the
same account still in flight or under recheck → 40901; vendor timeout → 50401 (the same
account is first rechecked by the original request id on the next submit); a matching result
within its validity is reused. Resubmitting with the same Idempotency-Key reuses that key's
verification record (in flight or recheck 40901, match saves, mismatch the original 30307,
still unknown at the deadline 50401) without a new verification or charge (BR-WDR-02 细则
「核验次数上限」). Needs X-Step-Up-Token for action payout_account_change (BR-WDR-02 ③; also
on the first binding). An abandoned Idempotency-Key is 20903 at the idempotency check,
without comparing the body or running the business; a business write that finds it
abandoned is rolled back with 20903 (04 §5「幂等」). Not realname → 30304; after a blocking
precondition the request is not replayed, the user saves again on the payout-account page
(BR-WDR-07 细则「前置步骤的回流」). Version gate: applied.

post.summary: Real-name verification (name and ID number)
post.description:
Two-element verification of name plus an 18-digit resident ID number, no face check
(BR-ID-25). The client only offers it when the user first enters a withdrawal or binds a
payout account while realname_status≠verified; no other entry may ask for the ID number.
Preconditions: no phone bound → 10005, checked before the consent (a member without phone
never gets 10004 or 30406, BR-ID-01 细则); no id_verification consent → 10004 with
data.consent_type=id_verification. Then, first hit wins (BR-ID-25): 20001 format (18
digits and check digit; the format is judged by the server, not by the request schema,
so that 10005 / 10004 come first) → 30407 age (computed locally from the ID number,
BR-ID-26) → 30410 today's attempts used up → 30405 (the ID number is already verified on
another account of this app; that account is never revealed) → vendor call. At most 3
attempts per user per natural day (+08:00): a vendor call with a definite result (match or
mismatch) counts 1, 30405 counts 1 (no vendor call); 20001, 30407 and vendor timeout or
error (50401 / 50301) do not count. The verification service being unavailable, including
not yet connected, is 50301 and does not count. A mismatch is 30406. A failed attempt
keeps neither the name nor the ID number. After verified the user cannot change it
themselves (corrections only by customer service in the admin console); a resubmission
after verified passes 10005 / 10004 and then answers 200 with the stored masked name,
ignoring the submitted values, without a vendor call or an attempt. A mismatch leaves the
user's realname_status failed. The name and the ID number never go into logs. The client
fetches GET /v1/me again after success. Version gate: applied.

get.summary: Current labor agreement and whether I must sign it
get.description:
The currently effective labor agreement version, the address of its full text, its sha256
and whether the user must sign (BR-WDR-31; 04 §6.1). need_sign is true when the user has
never signed, or when the latest signature's version is below the re-sign threshold
(resign_from_version, the first version that requires a new signature); a higher current
version that has not reached the threshold leaves a signed user with need_sign=false
(08 BR-WDR-31: one signature stays valid until a version marked as requiring a new
signature is published). signed_version / signed_at are the latest signature, null when
never signed. The version comes from server configuration; the
contract does not promise how it is managed in the admin console. Native App only, the
same as signing (04 §6.1): an h5_token gets 10403 even though this is a read. Not
realname → 30304.

200.description: The current labor agreement and the signing state.

post.summary: Sign the labor agreement
post.description:
Signs the currently effective labor agreement version (BR-WDR-31). Native App only: an
h5_token gets 10403, and neither JSBridge nor the Agent may sign on the user's behalf. The
signer is the verified real-name person; not realname → 30304. version not the currently
effective version → 20001 data.fields=[version]; text_sha256 not the digest of that
version → 20001 data.fields=[text_sha256]; agreed not true → 20001 data.fields=[agreed].
Every signature inserts one record and never changes an earlier one (version, text
digest, server time, signer snapshot, channel, device_id). The client fetches
GET /v1/me/labor-agreement again after success. Version gate: applied.

get.summary: Read states of the one-time tips
get.description:
jump_tip is read per platform (a platform without a record is absent or null);
inviter_before_buy is not per platform (BR-INV-03 细则). Fetched with /v1/config after
login; after a login on another device a tip already read on the same platform is not
shown again (BR-ATTR-21, AC-S1-17).

post.summary: Mark a tip as read
post.description:
tip_key=jump_tip needs a body {platform}; without it → 20001 with data.fields=[platform].
tip_key=inviter_before_buy sends no body. Repeating the call is harmless:
an existing record keeps its read_at. Version gate: applied.

delete.description:
Settings「重新显示下单须知」: clears the read records of jump_tip on every platform. Only
tip_key=jump_tip is accepted (the path parameter allows only that value; another value is
20001). Version gate: applied.

parameters.name: tip_key
parameters.description: Only jump_tip can be reset.

get.summary: My push settings
get.description:
Push switches per message category (BR-WATCH-19 ③, 拍板第二批 OPS-16): `service_push`
(trade and withdrawal messages are both service), `subscription_push` and
`marketing_push`. MVP opens only the service switch; subscription and marketing are
reserved and not shown by the client. A switch only affects push: with it off nothing of
that category is pushed, the in-app message is still written (GET /v1/messages). A user
who never saved settings gets all three true. PRD v2.1's /v1/notification-prefs is this
operation (04 §6.1). Not signed and no Idempotency-Key: 04 §6 marks neither S nor I.

200.description: My push settings (defaults when never saved).

put.description:
Full replacement, like the repository's other PUT operations that save a whole resource:
the body carries all three switches (`service_push`, `subscription_push`,
`marketing_push`); a missing or extra field is 20001 with data.fields. The MVP client only
shows service_push and sends the other two back as read from GET
/v1/me/notification-settings. Meanings as in GET (BR-WATCH-19 ③, 拍板第二批 OPS-16):
turning a switch off stops push for that category only, in-app messages are still written.
The response is the settings as saved. Saving the same values again changes nothing, so no
Idempotency-Key is required; not signed, as 04 §6 marks neither S nor I. Version gate:
applied.

get.summary: Progress of my account deletion
get.description:
The latest deletion request of the account (deletion_requests; flow in BR-ID-27); data is
null when there has never been one. can_cancel follows BR-ID-27: cooling and now before
cooling_until. Session scopes: accepts deletion_only (BR-ID-01 细则「受限会话」).

post.summary: Apply for account deletion
post.description:
Needs X-Step-Up-Token for action account_deletion (BR-ID-08). The client shows balance and
estimated earnings first and the user ticks the waiver (BR-ID-27, wording BR-TEXT-01). A
withdrawal in PENDING_REVIEW, APPROVED or PAYING is 30412 (not for a withdrawal frozen by
a ban, BR-ID-31); a negative balance is 30416 with data.amount_fen (拍板第二批 §8 ADD-07).
Success starts the 7-day cooling period and returns the request. An abandoned
Idempotency-Key is 20903 at the idempotency check, without comparing the body or running
the business; a business write that finds it abandoned is rolled back with 20903
(04 §5「幂等」). Version gate: not applied (申请注销, BR-ID-01 细则). Session scopes:
accepts deletion_only.

post.summary: Withdraw my account deletion
post.description:
Allowed while now < apply_at + 7×24 hours, judged by time and not by whether the scheduled
job has run; later → 10007 (BR-ID-27). Repeating a successful cancel returns the cancelled
request. Version gate: not applied (撤销注销, BR-ID-01 细则). Session scopes: accepts
deletion_only.

get.summary: My appeals
get.description:
Appeals of the current account only (the caller's own, account and order appeals alike),
newest first; the Appeal page shows progress and results from here (BR-ID-36). In the
10006 whitelist: a banned user, or one appealing a ban, can call it (BR-ID-31). The
internal deadline (appeals.deadline_at) and the handler are never returned: the
processing time limit is internal only and not shown to users (BR-ID-36 细则, BR-TEXT-23
细则). Only account and order appeals are listed: a blocked_request appeal is registered
by customer service in the admin console and its result is told in the WeCom (企业微信)
conversation, not here (04 §6.1; BR-ID-36 细则「被拦截请求申诉」).

items.content: 订单返利被作废，请核查。
另一笔订单返利被作废，请核查。

post.summary: Submit an appeal
post.description:
Appeal on the account (target_type=account) or on one order (target_type=order, target_id
= the order_id); who may appeal is BR-ID-36 (① account: risk_state banned or frozen;
② order: an order whose rebate risk control voided, BR-ATTR-26). At most one processing
appeal per target (the account, or one order): while one is processing, submitting again
returns that original appeal and creates no new one (BR-ID-36). An account appeal sets
risk_state to appealing and records prev_risk_state (BR-ID-36); target_type=order does not
change the account's risk state and only marks that order as under appeal (appeal_pending
on GET /v1/orders/{order_id}, 拍板第二批 OPS-07). For target_type=order an order_id that
is unknown or not the user's → 30701. How target_id is filled for target_type=account is
not set by 04 or BR-ID-36; the account appealed is always the caller's own. In the 10006
whitelist: a banned user, or one appealing a ban, can call it (BR-ID-31). The internal
deadline (appeals.deadline_at) and the handler are never returned: the processing time
limit is internal only and not shown to users (BR-ID-36 细则, BR-TEXT-23 细则). The result
reaches the user as the inbox message APPEAL_RESULT (BR-TEXT-23). Version gate: applied.

example.content: 订单返利被作废，请核查。

200.description: The appeal, new or the processing one already on this target.

data.content: 订单返利被作废，请核查。

post.summary: Abandon the idempotency key of a sensitive operation whose result is unknown
post.description:
Only for the pending state of the four x-step-up operations (04 §5 step-up row) after a
send whose result is unknown; the user chose to give up instead of confirming (BR-ID-10
细则「敏感操作的幂等键」). The server locates the idempotency record from the token's app_id
and user, the method and path that `action` maps to (the x-step-up table in
info.description) and `idempotency_key`:
- no record for the key → writes an abandoned record, `outcome=abandoned`, `original=null`;
- already abandoned → `outcome=abandoned` again (repeated calls give the same result);
- a completed record → `outcome=completed` and `original` = the stored response envelope
  `{code, msg, data}` unchanged (success or a 3xxxx business error); nothing is abandoned;
- the original request is still processing → 40901 (the client stays pending).
Afterwards a request with that key returns 20903. `action` or a key outside the formats →
20001 (`data.fields`). Takes no Idempotency-Key header and needs no step-up. Allowed for
frozen and deleting accounts (inside the 10006 and 10007 whitelists, BR-ID-31,
BR-ID-27); passing them checks login, signature and subject only and grants no right to
run the original operation. Single writer: platform. x-min-version-gate and
x-session-scopes are added by CT-17a.
Version gate (conditional): not applied when action=account_deletion (abandoning an unknown
deletion request); applied otherwise. Session scopes: a deletion_only session is accepted
only for action=account_deletion. Both per BR-ID-01 细则, which wins on any difference.

200.description: The key is abandoned, or its completed result is returned.

abandoned.summary: No record for the key; it is abandoned now

completed.summary: The original request had completed with a 3xxxx business error

original.msg: 有进行中的提现，暂不能申请注销

get.summary: Client configuration
get.description:
Configuration, client switches, texts and the derived per-platform purchase status
(04 §10.1, excerpt). Clients keep the last good response (LKG) and fall back to it and
then to the bundled default when the request fails (03 §4.3). Keys whose inner shape is
not fixed by 04 yet are free-form objects and get typed by the task that consumes them.
x-auth is optional (04 §6.2): h5_release buckets by user_id when logged in (拍板第二批
TECH-28) and agent availability depends on the whitelist user (BR-AI-12).
Session scopes: accepts deletion_only (BR-ID-01 细则「受限会话」).
Conditional request (02 §10, 03 §4.3): the 200 response carries a strong ETag whose value
without quotes equals data.config_version (04 §10.1); a request whose If-None-Match
matches the current ETag under weak comparison gets 304 with no body, and the client
keeps its LKG.

ETag.description:
Strong ETag of the configuration on 200; without quotes it equals data.config_version
(04 §10.1). A server that delivers it always sends it; a client that finds it missing
treats the configuration as having no config_version and sends no If-None-Match.

texts.withdraw.sla_text: 工作日 24 小时内处理

examples: 帮我找 500 元以内的降噪耳机

304.description: Not modified (If-None-Match matched); no body, the client keeps its LKG.

get.summary: Enum text dictionary
get.description:
The text dictionary of BR-TEXT-12 (02 §10, 04 §6.2 `GET /v1/dict`): clients read a text as
config.texts first, then this dictionary at `items[<dict>][<code>]`, then the bundled
default (contracts/texts.default.json), and cache the dictionary by `version`, which
equals data.dict_version of GET /v1/config. `version` in the query is only a cache hint:
the response is always the whole current dictionary, also when it equals the current
version (no 304; the client compares versions itself, 编排者默认). A dictionary key
`<dict>.<code>` is split at its first dot: `dict` is the first segment and `code` the
rest (a key without a dot has the empty string as code). Keys whose current text is null
(set back to the bundled default) are left out. Before the first publish `version` is
"0" and `items` is empty. Readable anonymously, without a device id. Session scopes:
accepts deletion_only (BR-ID-01 细则「受限会话」: the forced-update and deletion pages
read it).

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The dictionary version the client has cached; a hint only, the whole dictionary is returned either way.

order_status.CREDITED.summary: 这笔返利已到账，可以去钱包提现，详情见卡片。

get.summary: Search one platform
get.description:
Keyword search on one platform (04 §6.3). Coupon-price and rebate sorting reorder only
the current page (拍板第二批 TRADE-20). The cursor is opaque and carries only the search
session and page (BR-PROD-08); no_rebate items are filtered out (BR-PRICE-08). With no
result the response carries `fallback_items` (the platform's first 10 feed items). Union
failure without a usable cache returns 50304 with `data.platform` (BR-PROD-07); the
product pool is never served as search results. Cards only register a link_id with its
quote snapshot and are not converted (BR-PRICE-12): buying goes through
`POST /v1/links/{link_id}/open`. `x-auth` is optional although 04 §6.3 lists none:
rebate amounts are computed for the current user and links are registered per user
(BR-PRICE-11, BR-PRICE-12; 08 wins over 04).
When the search switch search.enabled.<platform> is off the answer is 50304 with
data.reason=search_disabled (BR-PROD-10 细则「按平台的搜索开关」).

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Platform to search (enum platform).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keyword.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (enum sort); default relevance.

parameters.name: has_coupon
parameters.description: Only items with a coupon.

parameters.name: price_min_fen
parameters.description: Lower bound of final_price_fen, inclusive.

parameters.name: price_max_fen
parameters.description: Upper bound of final_price_fen, inclusive.

get.summary: Product detail
get.description:
Coupon, final price, estimated rebate and quote time of one product (BR-PRICE-05,
BR-PRICE-11), with a freshly registered `link_id` (BR-PRICE-12). On union failure the
server may answer with the product-pool price and `stale=true` (拍板第二批 TRADE-12).
A response whose derived key differs from the requested one, or cannot be derived, is
30143 ref_expired (BR-PROD-03, BR-PROD-05). `item_ref` of the card the user tapped is
passed through unchanged (BR-PROD-11). x-auth optional for the same reason as search.

parameters.name: item_ref
parameters.description: Opaque `item_ref` of the card that was tapped (BR-PROD-11); never parsed.

200.description: The product card of the detail page.

get.summary: Price trend of one product
get.description:
Final price of the last 30 days for the folded price-trend module of the product detail
page (规划/01 F-PROD-14; BR-WATCH-05, BR-WATCH-19, BR-PROD-03). Read only from
price_snapshot; never reads the watch observation tables or any third-party service, so
nothing about the product's current state (off shelf, ref expired) is reported here.
One point per natural day in +08:00, the last record of that day; records of one day
from several sources rank detail, then search, then quote. `start_date` is the date of the
first record in the window (plain date, BR-TEXT-11), `window_days` is 30. Fewer than
`price_trend.min_distinct_days` distinct dates, or the platform's key_stability not yet
stable_7d, gives status=no_data with empty points and null start_date (the client shows
price_trend.empty); an unknown product key is the same no_data. `source_key` is
price_trend.source, or price_trend.source.general for a product whose detail quote
carries no coupon (BR-PRICE-04); the title key follows the same choice. A `platform`
that is not a platform code, or a product key that does not belong to it, is 20001 with
data.fields.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Platform of the product (enum platform).

get.summary: My favorites
get.description:
Favorites of the current user, newest favorited first (规划/01 F-PROD-12). Each item has
`platform`, `product_key`, `favorited_at`, `invalid` and `product_card`. The list card has
the same shape as a search card (ProductCard) and only registers a link and a quote
snapshot, never converts (TRADE-03). `invalid=true` when fetching the card the union
answered that the product does not exist, is off shelf or cannot be promoted; such an
item's card has only the title and the image, no price and no rebate_*. Only product
references and times are stored, never prices, links or tokens. `next_cursor` fetches the
next (older) page; null means no more. A malformed or foreign cursor is 20001 with
data.fields=[cursor].

200.description: One page of my favorites, newest first.

put.description:
Favorites one product (规划/01 F-PROD-12). Unique per (app, user, platform, product_key):
when the product is already a favorite the original record is returned and no row is
added. Adding a new one when the user already has `favorites.max_per_user` favorites is
20001 with data.reason=favorites_full (client shows error.20001.favorites_full as a light
hint, no dialog); an existing favorite is returned even at the limit. Only the product
reference and the time are stored. A product key that does not belong to `platform` is
20001 with data.fields=[product_key]. Version gate: applied.

200.description: The favorite, new or the one already recorded.

delete.description:
Removes one favorite; the row is physically deleted (规划/01 F-PROD-12). A product that is
not a favorite is success as well. A product key that does not belong to `platform` is
20001 with data.fields=[product_key]. Version gate: applied.

post.summary: Remove several favorites
post.description:
Removes the listed favorites, at most 100 items (规划/01 F-PROD-12); rows are physically
deleted, items that are not favorites are skipped, and the call succeeds. More than 100
items, or an item whose product key does not belong to its platform, is 20001 with
data.fields. Version gate: applied.

200.description: None of the listed products is a favorite any more.

post.summary: Recognise pasted links, tokens or share text
post.description:
Shared by clipboard, search box, share extension and Agent (04 §8.5). At most 3 links or
tokens of one text are handled, one card each; the same product key yields one card
(BR-PROD-08 ⑤). Cards only register a link_id with the quote snapshot and are never
converted here (拍板第二批 TRADE-03); a pasted link without rebate still yields a card
with `rebate_basis=no_rebate` (BR-PRICE-08). Nothing recognisable as a concrete product
returns 30132 without candidate cards (拍板第二批 TRADE-07); a recognised product
whose key cannot be derived returns 30131 (BR-PROD-03). How a platform turns a link or
token into a product is the union adapter's business and is not visible here. x-auth is
optional although 04 §6.3 lists none, for the same reason as search.

200.description: One result per recognised link or token, in input order.

post.summary: Buy — re-check the price and convert
post.description:
The only entry for a purchase tap (拍板第二批 TRADE-03): converts in real time with the
identity fixed in the link snapshot and re-checks the price before the jump
(BR-PRICE-13; ownership rules BR-ATTR-05). `price_changed=true` means the client asks
the user before jumping; whenever the new price differs, `new_link_id` replaces the card
(BR-PRICE-12). Re-check failure with a cached link of this user ≤ 900 s jumps with
`requote_failed=true`; without cache, 50303. A `no_rebate=true` open does not need the
re-check to succeed: on re-check failure it still jumps with `requote_failed=true`, no
rebate and no quote snapshot, converted on the self_buy slot without user parameters, or
to the unpromoted product page when that conversion fails too (BR-PRICE-13, BR-ID-18,
BR-PRICE-08); a share link opened by anyone but the sharer ignores `no_rebate`. Share
links open anonymously; other links need login (10001). amount_unknown cards are converted without price re-check
(BR-PRICE-08). The client waits at most 8 s and retries with the same Idempotency-Key
(拍板第二批 TRADE-22). Every call writes a link_log `open` row (BR-ATTR-14). When the
rebate drops from > 0 to 0 (new_rebate_max_fen = 0) the client also asks before jumping,
even with price_changed=false (BR-PRICE-13).
A request stopped by 30101, 30102 or 30111 and sent again after the user authorized is a
new request with a new Idempotency-Key; the original key is only for retrying the same
request (BR-ID-10 细则). 30101 / 30102 carry auth_url, state and auth_methods; 30111
carries auth_jump.
A share link opened by anyone but the sharer while the sharer's own authorization is no
longer valid (Taobao binding not active, or Pinduoduo filing invalid) gets 30102 (Taobao)
or 30111 (Pinduoduo) with data.reason=sharer_auth_invalid and no auth_url, state or
auth_jump; this holds during a site-owner authorization outage too (never
auth_unavailable here). The opener is not the one to authorize: the client shows no
AuthSheet, does not replay the link, offers no no-rebate purchase and shows
link_landing.invalid (BR-ATTR-05 细则「别人的分享 link 不可用」).

200.description: Jump plan and price re-check result.

post.summary: Register and convert in one call (entries without a link_id)
post.description:
Only for entries that have no link_id, such as the H5 bridge method
`trade.convertAndOpen` (scene=h5): registers the link and then
re-checks and converts exactly like open, returning `link_id` plus the open result
(拍板第二批 TRADE-03). Pass `product_key` with the tapped card's `item_ref` (a missing
item_ref is not an error, BR-PROD-11), or `url`. A url whose product key cannot be
derived is 30131 and nothing is registered (BR-PROD-03). A missing or invalid `scene`
is 20001 (BR-ATTR-08). Writes a link_log `convert` row (BR-ATTR-14).
A request stopped by 30101, 30102 or 30111 and sent again after the user authorized is a
new request with a new Idempotency-Key; the original key is only for retrying the same
request (BR-ID-10 细则). 30101 / 30102 carry auth_url, state and auth_methods; 30111
carries auth_jump.

200.description: The registered link and its jump plan.

get.summary: Card of a link for the in-app link landing page
get.description:
Card data for the in-app link landing page (route LinkLanding, 01 §4.2; BR-ATTR-05 细则
「App 内打开链接的入口」). Read-only: registers no link, writes no link_log and converts
nothing. Returns link_kind (share | other), the shared product card subset (the same as
the share page: no rebate_* and no est_net_price_fen, BR-PRICE-06, BR-ATTR-10),
quoted_at, and viewer_is_sharer (true only with a token whose user is the sharer of this
share link; used only to show a hint, BR-ATTR-11). Unknown link or one of another app →
30144; the page has no card to re-convert from, shows the empty state and does not retry.
Buying still goes only through POST /v1/links/{link_id}/open.

200.description: The link kind and its card.

get.summary: Card data of the share page
get.description:
Card data of the share page outside the app (F-SHARE-01, 01 §4.2): the shared product card
subset (no rebate_* and no est_net_price_fen, BR-PRICE-06), quoted_at, jump_url (the
sharer's converted short link used for the jump; never contains a token, in any
environment), tpwd_ticket and open_in_app_url. tpwd_ticket is the short-lived ticket for
POST /v1/share-pages/{link_id}/tpwd: returned only when the server judges the request's
User-Agent to be outside WeChat and the link has a token, otherwise null (a request
without User-Agent counts as WeChat). The User-Agent is the client's claim, only used to
adapt the page, not a guarantee of content isolation (BR-ATTR-10 细则). open_in_app_url
is the LinkLanding deep link, null while share.open_in_app.enabled is off (BR-ATTR-05
细则「App 内打开链接的入口」). Only links with pid_scene=share are answered; any other,
unknown or of another app → 30144. When the sharer's own authorization is no longer
valid (Taobao binding not active, or Pinduoduo filing invalid; JD is not checked) →
30102 (Taobao) or 30111 (Pinduoduo) with data.reason=sharer_auth_invalid and no
auth_url, state or auth_jump; this holds during a site-owner authorization outage too
(never auth_unavailable here). The share page shows 「分享链接已失效，请联系分享者重新分享」
and offers no authorization, replay or no-rebate purchase (BR-ATTR-05 细则「别人的分享
link 不可用」). The response carries Cache-Control: no-store (not cached by the CDN). Not
signed; no X-Device-Id required.

post.summary: Token of the share page for the copy-token button
post.description:
Called when the user taps the copy-token button on the share page: the body carries the
tpwd_ticket of GET /v1/share-pages/{link_id}; returns the token (BR-ATTR-10 细则). The
ticket is bound to the link_id, valid 600 s, at most 3 exchanges. An invalid, expired or
used-up ticket, or a request whose User-Agent is the WeChat in-app browser or missing →
20001 with data.fields=[ticket], no token. Rate limited per IP × link_id
(share.tpwd_rate_per_min) → 42901 with Retry-After. The response carries Cache-Control:
no-store. Not signed. Version gate: 不判定：非三端请求 (written false, BR-ID-01 细则).

post.summary: Admin login, first step (account and password)
post.description:
First step of the admin login (BR-ID-34; 04 §6.6 auth). The source IP must be on the admin
whitelist (10403 `data.reason=admin_ip_not_allowed`, checked before the password). A wrong
account or password is 10008 without data (an unknown account is not told apart) and
counts towards the consecutive-failure lock; a locked account gets 10009 with
`data.locked_until` even with the right password.
Success never issues an admin_token: it returns a `login_ticket` for exactly the step in
`next` — `totp` (bound authenticator: POST /admin/v1/auth/totp), `change_password` (still on
the initial password: POST /admin/v1/auth/password, then the binding) or `bind_totp` (no
authenticator bound: POST /admin/v1/auth/totp/secret, then POST
/admin/v1/auth/totp/bind). The ticket can call nothing but that step; its lifetime is set
by the server and given in `ticket_expires_at`.
Not decided by BR-ID-34 and not fixed here: how the initial password is handed out beyond
the rule itself, the reset of a lost authenticator (a super-admin action, later task).

200.description: Account and password accepted; the next step and its ticket.

totp.summary: Authenticator bound, enter the current code

changePassword.summary: First login on the initial password, change it first

bindTotp.summary: No authenticator bound yet, bind one

post.summary: Replace the initial password during the first login
post.description:
Takes a `login_ticket` whose `next` was `change_password` (BR-ID-34 细则「首次登录强制改密码」).
The new password must differ from the initial one, which stops working once replaced; a
new password that is rejected is 20001 with `data.fields=[new_password]` and the ticket
stays usable. Password composition rules are not fixed by BR-ID-34 and are left to the
admin module task. Success consumes the ticket and returns the next step (`bind_totp` for a
new account) with a new ticket; no admin_token is issued before the binding is done.
A ticket that is expired, already used, invalid or issued for another step is 10001 with
`data.reason=login_ticket_expired` (back to the first step). A locked account is 10009.

200.description: Password replaced; the next step and its ticket.

post.summary: Authenticator secret for the first binding
post.description:
Takes a `login_ticket` whose `next` was `bind_totp` and returns the TOTP secret and its
otpauth URI (the page draws the QR code from the URI) for the account holder to add to an
authenticator app (BR-ID-34 细则「首次绑定身份验证器」). It does not consume the ticket:
calling it again with the same ticket returns the same secret; a new login after leaving or
timing out generates a new one. Nothing is bound until POST /admin/v1/auth/totp/bind
accepts a code. POST so that neither ticket nor secret appears in a URL.
A ticket that is expired, already used, invalid or issued for another step is 10001 with
`data.reason=login_ticket_expired`. A locked account is 10009.

/admin/v1/auth/totp/secret. A correct code stores the binding and issues the admin_token
(login complete). A wrong code binds nothing and signs nothing in: 20002 with
`data.reason=totp_bind_invalid`, the ticket stays usable for another try, and every such
failure counts towards the same consecutive-failure lock as a wrong password (BR-ID-34
细则「首次绑定身份验证器」); requests during the lock get 10009. A ticket that is expired,
already used, invalid or issued for another step is 10001 with
`data.reason=login_ticket_expired`.

post.description:
Takes the `totp` ticket from POST /admin/v1/auth/login and the current 6-digit code. A
correct code issues the admin_token (BR-ID-34). A wrong code is 20002 with
`data.reason=totp_invalid`, the ticket stays usable for another try, and every such failure
counts towards the consecutive-failure lock; requests during the lock get 10009. A ticket
that is expired, already used, invalid or issued for another step is 10001 with
`data.reason=login_ticket_expired`.

post.description:

sessionStorage. An expired or idle-timed-out token is answered 10001 like on any admin
operation; nothing is written.

post.description:
Sends a verification code to the verify phone registered on the signed-in admin account
(BR-ID-34 短信档; template ADMIN_STEP_UP). An account without a registered verify phone is
10003 with `data.tier=sms` and `data.reason=verify_phone_missing` and nothing is sent (the
console greys out sms-tier buttons beforehand from `verify_phone_masked` of GET
/admin/v1/me/permissions). Sending too often is 42901 with Retry-After. The send limits and
the code validity are not fixed by BR-ID-34; the response states the values in force.
