EntryName.description: Process entry that produced the response (ADR-0001 §2).

now.description: Current instant of the process clock (follows CLOCK_NOW outside prod).

HealthzResponse.description: Response envelope of 规划/04 §5 carrying the health payload.

TraceId.description: Echo of a well-formed X-Trace-Id request header, otherwise a generated UUID.

ProductKey.description: `<key_prefix>:<stable_id>`, at most 128 characters, opaque to clients (BR-PROD-02).

ItemRef.description: Server-signed opaque product reference; passed through unchanged (BR-PROD-11).

NullableFen.description: Amount in fen, null when unknown.

NoRebateCause.description: Why a card or an open result has no rebate (enum no_rebate_cause).

RebateBasis.description:
contracts/enums/trade.yaml rebate_basis. The three 查返利 states are derived from
coupon_fen and rebate_basis only (BR-PRICE-21); amount_unknown and login_required are
outside them.

InstalledState.description:
Whether the platform app is installed, as detected by the client (BR-ATTR-27 ①); the
strings "true" / "false" / "unknown" (enum installed_state).

JumpStep.description:
One step of a jump plan. `sdk` is required on every type=sdk step and never present on any
other type; the schema keeps it optional so the already-served shape stays compatible, and
the server that builds the plan (linking) guarantees the pairing, checked against the
examples by the contracts-ts consistency test. For a type=sdk step the client acts on
`sdk` only; `value` repeats `sdk.url` (open_by=url) or `sdk.item_id` (open_by=code) for
logs and compatibility.

value.description: URL, scheme or token to execute; produced by the server only.

BaichuanOpen.description:
Taobao open instruction executed by the Baichuan SDK (docs/changes/20261003 §1; 03 §4.5).
The server builds it from the link snapshot; the client passes it to the SDK unchanged and
never rewrites, fills in or drops `taoke` (BR-ATTR-05). open_by=url opens our own promotion
link of this user and scene and carries no commission parameter at all (BR-ATTR-27 Taobao
row); open_by=code opens the item detail page and lets the SDK convert with `taoke`. A
code step carries no URL, so JumpPlan.expire_at does not limit it (04 §8.4). Whether the
SDK returns to the app afterwards is a platform capability (CAP-TB-11), not promised here.
The oneOf branches declare the properties they constrain (strict Ajv2020, ADR-0001 §4.2
#15).

open_by.description: url = openByUrl with our promotion link; code = openByCode with the item ID.

url.description: Required for open_by=url; only our own promotion link of this user and scene.

page.description: Required for open_by=code; the page openByCode opens.

item_id.description: Required for open_by=code; the union item ID (new string form).

BaichuanTaoke.description:
AlibcTaokeParams of an open_by=code instruction, built by linking from the snapshot
identity (BR-ATTR-05); the client must not change, fill in or drop any of it.

relation_id.description: Active binding of the snapshot user (the sharer on a share link).

JumpPlan.description:
Executed strictly in order; clients never build schemes or add fallbacks themselves
(BR-ATTR-27, 03 §4.5). The client jumps only after a user tap (BR-ATTR-21).

expire_at.description:
Until when the returned union URL can be used directly (BR-ATTR-05); it does not
limit opening the link_id again. A Taobao sdk step with open_by=code carries no URL and
is not limited by it (04 §8.4).

IdempotencyKey.description: Value of the Idempotency-Key header (04 §5「幂等」).

SessionScope.description: scp of an access token (enum session_scope; meaning in BR-ID-01 细则「受限会话」).

H5TokenScope.description: Scope of an h5_token (enum h5_token_scope; BR-ID-32 细则「只读作用域」).

scope.description:
Filled by the native app from its force-update state; H5 cannot choose it. The value
used when it is absent is set in BR-ID-32 细则「只读作用域」.

StepUpAction.description: Action a step_up_token is bound to; one per x-step-up operation (04 §2.5, §5).

AbandonIdempotencyKeyData.description:
`original` is null exactly when `outcome=abandoned`. The oneOf branches declare the
properties they constrain (strict Ajv2020, ADR-0001 §4.2 #15).

original.description:
The response envelope stored with the completed idempotency record, unchanged
(`code` 0 or a 3xxxx business code; 1xxxx and 2xxxx results are never stored,
BR-WDR-07). `data` keeps the shape of the original operation, so it is left open.

ErrorEnvelope.description:
Error response (04 §5, §7). `data` is present only for codes that define it; its fields
per code are listed in contracts/error-codes.yaml, so it is left open here.

msg.description: Fallback text only; clients show the dictionary text error.<code>.

FreeForm.description: Configuration block whose inner shape is not fixed by 规划/04 yet.

ConfigClipboard.description:
Clipboard block of /v1/config (04 §10.1). consent_version is the current version (a
string) of the purpose statement for automatic clipboard recognition; the client compares
it with the user's feature consent version (BR-ID-16 门槛②). The other fields (local
filter rules and so on) are typed later by the contract / native line and pass through
as-is for now. When the stored value does not fit this shape the server sends {} for the
whole key (04 config_items 统一规则).

DeviceIdSource.description: Which device identifier was hashed (enum device_id_source, BR-ID-09).

device_hash.description:
lowercase_hex(SHA-256(UTF-8 bytes of the identifier, trimmed and lower-cased)) of IDFV
(iOS), ANDROID_ID (Android, MVP) or ODID (Harmony) (BR-ID-09 细则「设备标识的无效值」).

install_secret.description: Signing secret, stored only in Keychain / Keystore / HUKS.

Phone.description:
Phone number as typed or pasted; it may carry spaces, hyphens and +86 / 0086 / 86. The
server normalises it (BR-ID-05 细则「手机号规范化」); a result that is not a mainland mobile
number is 20001 with `data.fields=[phone]` and `data.reason=phone_invalid` (an empty
string included). No length bound in the schema: any spacing of a valid number must reach
the normaliser, and adding a bound to a request property is a breaking change (oasdiff).

action.description:
With purpose=step_up the client always sends the action the code is for; the version
gate and the session scope are decided from it (BR-ID-01 细则): only
action=account_deletion is exempt, and a step_up request without action is gated.
purpose=login is exempt regardless of action; purpose=bind is gated.

resend_after_sec.description:
Seconds until another code may be requested: at least 60, the latest release among the
per-phone limits (BR-ID-05).

expires_in_sec.description: Validity of the code in seconds (300, BR-ID-05).

LegalVersions.description: Versions of the privacy policy and user agreement the user agreed to (BR-ID-04).

consent_at.description: When the box was ticked or the confirm dialog accepted (client clock).

invite_code.description: Optional invite code; ignored for an existing account (BR-INV-06).

version.description:
The version of the text the user saw. A positive integer (legal.privacy.version and the
like) for every type except clipboard_auto_import, which takes the string
config.clipboard.consent_version (BR-ID-12 细则, BR-ID-16). A form that does not pair
with `type` → 20001 with data.fields=[version].

channel.description: consent_channel without the server-written login_merge, h5_landing and withdraw_flow.

OauthAttemptPurpose.description: What a third-party authorization attempt is for (enum oauth_attempt_purpose).

CreateOauthAttemptRequest.description:
`action` is required exactly for purpose=step_up. purpose=payout_bind is for WeChat only
and carries no `action`. The oneOf branches declare the properties they constrain (strict
Ajv2020, ADR-0001 §4.2 #15).

nonce.description: At least 128 random bits, passed to the provider SDK (BR-ID-04 细则).

OauthCredential.description: An authorization credential from the provider SDK; never stored or logged.

StepUpRequest.description:
Exactly one way of second verification: an SMS code, or a new authorization with one
provider carrying that provider's login credential fields (BR-ID-08). Each branch is a
closed object, so a body mixing two ways matches none.

TokenPair.description:
Token pair of a login or a refresh. session_scope is the scp of the access token, decided
from this request (BR-ID-01 细则「受限会话」): deletion_only when the client is below the
minimum supported version.

InviteBind.description: Result of binding the invite code sent at registration (BR-INV-06).

code.description: Error code when result=failed (50001 = internal binding error).

MeBalance.description: Summary of the single balance (拍板第二批 §8 ADD-06); meanings per BR-FUND-18.

AuthMethod.description: Taobao authorization method (enum auth_method; BR-ID-17 细则「授权方式」).

type.description: A subset of jump_type; an h5 step opens in the system browser, not in the app.

AuthJumpPlan.description:
Authorization jump of 30111 and of the Pinduoduo auth-url (04 §7 30111): primary and
fallbacks chosen by the server from the device record and installed (BR-ID-22 细则,
BR-ATTR-27); executed in order by the same executor as a purchase jump plan, but not
reported as link_jump and not a purchase jump (BR-ATTR-21).

UnionAuthUrlData.description:
Exactly one of auth_methods (Taobao, ordered) and auth_jump (Pinduoduo); the oneOf branches
declare the property they require (strict Ajv2020).

expires_in.description: Lifetime of the access token in seconds, as the SDK returned it.

BindUnionRequest.description:
Exactly one authorization method (BR-ID-17 细则「授权方式」); each branch is closed, so
undefined fields are 20001.

OrderStatusGroup.description: Status group of the order list (enum order_status_group; members in BR-TEXT-02 细则).

OrderDisplayStatus.description: User-visible order status (enum display_status; BR-FUND-17); unknown codes map to UNKNOWN.

OrderReasonCode.description: Order reason code (enum order_reason); texts and actions come from /v1/dict.

OrderTimelineNode.description:
Timeline node of the order detail (enum order_timeline_node; BR-TEXT-02 细则「时间线」):
a pre-sale order starts with deposit_paid and has final_paid instead of paid; invalid /
clawed_back / part_clawed_back only when the order reached that state.

OrderSummary.description:
One row of GET /v1/orders. Exactly one of order_no (my own purchase) and masked_order_no (a
shared order); the oneOf branches declare the property they require (strict Ajv2020). A
shared order with is_other_product=true has title and image_url null and never the full
order_no (BR-TEXT-02 细则
「订单的检索范围与分享单的投影」). OrderDetail repeats these fields (kept as two closed
objects; redocly's example check closes every allOf member, so no shared allOf base).

order_no.description: Full platform order number (self-purchase only, copyable).

masked_order_no.description: Masked by the server (BR-TEXT-02 细则「订单号的显示」); shared orders never carry the full number.

paid_at.description:
Payment time (the final payment of a pre-sale order); null for a pre-sale order still in
DEPOSIT_PAID (BR-ATTR-25 keeps paid_at for the final payment).

is_other_product.description: A shared order whose bought product is not the shared one.

claim_entry_pinned.description: Whether the claim entry is pinned on the order page (J-6). Only with scope=self, absent with scope=share; computed by the server at the current time per BR-ATTR-17 (latest own jump-out at least 30 minutes and at most 72 hours ago and no new order attributed to the user since; a no-rebate purchase counts only under 拍板第二批 TRADE-09). Not the same as show_claim_entry of the pending-track card.

ClaimItemDecision.description: Decision on one child order of a claim (enum claim_item_decision).

ClaimRejectReason.description: Reject reason of a child order (enum claim_reject_reason; NOT_IN_POOL and ORDER_INVALID are set by the system).

order_no.description: Order number; spaces are removed, then it is matched exactly as a string, first against child order numbers, then against parent order numbers (BR-ATTR-17). For pdd the hyphens are removed from both the input and the stored numbers before comparing; stored and displayed numbers are unchanged. Empty after removing spaces is 20001.

paid_date.description: Payment date, YYYY-MM-DD in +08:00 (second factor); for a pre-sale order the date the deposit was paid.

order_no.description: The order number as submitted, spaces removed.

at.description: When it happened; null when it has not (shown greyed) or the platform gives no time.

period.description: Expected settlement month (YYYY-MM), only on credit_expected; null otherwise.

OrderDetail.description:
The list row fields (same as OrderSummary) plus the detail fields of 04 §6.4. product_key
is null when is_other_product=true; with is_other_product=true title and image_url are
null too.

order_no.description: Full platform order number (self-purchase only, copyable).

masked_order_no.description: Masked by the server (BR-TEXT-02 细则「订单号的显示」); shared orders never carry the full number.

paid_at.description:
Payment time (the final payment of a pre-sale order); null for a pre-sale order still in
DEPOSIT_PAID (BR-ATTR-25 keeps paid_at for the final payment).

is_other_product.description: A shared order whose bought product is not the shared one.

reason_action.description: Action codes of the reason (the order_reason dictionary's action[], BR-TEXT-05).

provider.description: Push provider; a string until the provider is chosen (D-14).

code.description: purpose=bind SMS code sent to the new number.

nickname.description:
New nickname. The server trims leading and trailing white space and checks the length
as 1–16 extended grapheme clusters (BR-ID-39); no minLength / maxLength here because
JSON Schema counts code points.

merge_ticket.description:
data.merge_ticket of the 30411 returned by POST /v1/me/phone; valid for 5 minutes and
once. Its format is not part of the contract.

invite_code.description:
Invite code as typed or pasted. The server normalises it and checks the format
(BR-INV-02); an empty or malformed code is 30401 and counts towards the daily limit, so
the schema has no pattern or minLength.

can_invite.description: false when inviter_unavailable(self) (BR-INV-02); the reason is not given.

invite_code.description: My invite code; null when can_invite=false.

landing_url.description:
`{share domain}/i/{invite_code}`, optionally with a channel code parameter; never the
UID, phone number or nickname. null when can_invite=false.

poster_url.description:
Poster image drawn by the server (04 §6.4, TECH-13); null when can_invite=false and
while poster drawing is not available.

direct_count.description: Number of my direct invitees (BR-INV-16); returned even when can_invite=false.

sms_code.description:
The purpose=login code from POST /v1/landing/sms-codes; a wrong or expired code is
20002 / 20003 (BR-ID-05).

invite_code.description:
Invite code of the landing link. Normalised and checked by the server (BR-INV-02); an
empty or malformed code is 30401 and counts towards the daily limit, so the schema has
no pattern or minLength.

agreed.description:
The user agreement and privacy policy box was ticked. false is 10004 with
data.consent_type=agreement, not a validation error; on success the agreement and
privacy consents are recorded with channel h5_landing (BR-INV-05, BR-ID-32).

channel.description:
Optional channel code of the landing link, kept as the account's registered channel
(BR-ID-04, BR-INV-05).

result.description:
registered = account created and bound to the inviter; already_registered = the phone
already has an account (in deletion included), nothing changed (BR-INV-05).

TipKey.description: One-time tip (enum tip_key; BR-ATTR-21, BR-INV-03 细则).

ResettableTipKey.description: The tip that settings can show again (subset of tip_key).

MarkTipReadRequest.description: Body of tip_key=jump_tip; tip_key=inviter_before_buy sends no body.

jump_tip.description: read_at per platform; a platform never read is absent or null.

AppealTargetType.description:
Subset of contracts/enums/identity.yaml appeal_target_type (04 §6.1, BR-ID-36): the
user-side appeal endpoints take and return account and order only. blocked_request (a
write request blocked with 44001) is registered by customer service in the admin console
only and is not accepted here (04 §3.2 appeals, §6.1; BR-ID-36 细则「被拦截请求申诉」).

Appeal.description:
One of my appeals (04 §3.2 appeals). No deadline_at or handler_id: the processing time
limit is internal only (BR-ID-36 细则).

target_id.description:
The order_id when target_type=order. For target_type=account how it is filled is not
set by 04 or BR-ID-36.

closed_at.description: When the appeal was closed (upheld or revoked); null while processing.

InviteBackfill.description:
Whether the invite code can still be filled in and until when (computed by the server per
BR-INV-07, also for an account without phone; BR-INV-03 细则).

PayoutAccount.description: The current payout account, by payout_method (bank_name only for a bank card).

masked_account.description: Masked by the server (BR-ID-33 细则「收款账号的脱敏格式」).
Masked by the server (BR-ID-33 细则「收款账号的脱敏格式」).

data.description: The account, or an empty object when nothing is bound.

alipay_logon_id.description: Alipay logon id (phone or e-mail form), normalised by the server (BR-WDR-02 细则).

card_no.description:
Card number as typed; the server removes spaces and hyphens, then checks 12–19 digits and
Luhn (20001 data.fields=[card_no], BR-WDR-02 ⑥ and 细则).

bank_name.description: Opening bank as chosen by the user (04 §6.1).

name.description: Real name as typed; normalised by the server.

id_no.description:
18-digit resident ID number as typed. No pattern here: length and check digit are judged
by the server (20001 data.fields=[id_no], BR-ID-25) after the phone and consent checks.

realname_status.description: contracts/enums/identity.yaml realname_status; always verified on success.

LaborAgreement.description: Currently effective labor agreement and the user's signing state (BR-WDR-31).

text_url.description: Address of the full text of that version.

text_sha256.description: Lower-case hex sha256 of that version's text.

need_sign.description:
True when the user has never signed, or the latest signature's version is below the
re-sign threshold (resign_from_version); a higher current version below the threshold
does not require signing again (08 BR-WDR-31).

signed_version.description:
Version of the latest signature (may be below the current version when no re-signing
is required); null when never signed.

signed_at.description: Server time of the latest signature; null when never signed.

version.description: The version shown to the user (GET /v1/me/labor-agreement); must be the current one.

text_sha256.description: sha256 of the text shown; must match that version (20001 data.fields=[text_sha256]).

agreed.description: Must be true; the server returns 20001 data.fields=[agreed] otherwise.

PublicAgreement.description: The currently effective version of the privacy policy or the user agreement (04 §6.2).

min_version.description: Consent to a version below this one must be given again (BR-ID-12).

article_version.description: Version of the article holding the text (GET /v1/articles/{article_id}?version=).

text_sha256.description: Lower-case hex sha256 of the text.

url.description: Address of the full text of this version.

privacy.description: The current privacy policy; null when never published.

agreement.description: The current user agreement; null when never published.

ArticleCategory.description: Article category (04 §6.2：帮助、规则、公告、协议; codes defined here, no enums/ entry yet).

RouteTarget.description:
In-app jump target {route, params} (contracts/routes.json; TECH-04). route stays a string on
purpose: a server may return a route newer than an installed client, which then opens the
upgrade page (03 §4.4), so the HTTP contract cannot pin the route list. The client checks
route and params against its own routes table (bridge RouteTarget) before opening; the
server only stores targets checked against routes.json when they are saved.

NoticeItem.description:
One notice-bar entry, shared by the static (home schema) and api (GET /v1/articles notice
category) sources; closing and content-version rules only in BR-TEXT-13 细则「首页公告条的
关闭与内容版本」 (04 §6.2).

not.description: A notice that cannot be closed must have end_at (BR-TEXT-13 细则「生效区间」).

item_id.description: For api entries the notice article id.

ArticleSummary.description: A list item; items of the notice category carry notice (04 §6.2), others do not.

ArticleVersionStatus.description:
Status of one article version row (04 §6.2): draft = saved, never published; published =
published (counts only once published_at is not later than now); offline = taken offline.

AdminArticleSummary.description: One article in the admin list.

title.description: Title of the newest version row.

current_version.description: Largest published version already due; null = none.

published_at.description: published_at of the current version; null when there is none.

row_version.description: The article's CAS value (row_version of the newest version row).

AdminArticleVersion.description: One version row of an article.

body.description: tiptap JSON document as a string.

notice_closable.description: Notices only; true for other categories.

notice_content_version.description: Maintained by the server on save (BR-TEXT-13 细则「首页公告条的关闭与内容版本」).

notice_end_at.description: End of the notice's effective window; null for other categories.

published_at.description: Publish time (a later time = scheduled); null for a version never published.

AdminArticle.description: An article with every version row.

row_version.description:
The article's CAS value (row_version of the newest version row): a draft save gives the
new row the previous newest row's value + 1, publish and offline add 1 to the newest
row, never going back.

current_version.description: Largest published version already due; null = none.

versions.description: Every version row, newest first, drafts and offline versions included.

article_id.description:
Client-generated UUIDv7 (lowercase canonical form), generated once per new article and
reused on every retry of the same create. An id that already exists → 20902
`data.resource=article` (no second article); read it back with GET
/admin/v1/articles/{article_id}.

body.description: tiptap JSON document as a string.

notice_closable.description: Notices only (default true); ignored for other categories.

notice_end_at.description: Notices only; required when notice_closable is false. Ignored for other categories.

body.description: tiptap JSON document as a string.

notice_closable.description: Notices only (default true); ignored for other categories.

notice_end_at.description: Notices only; required when notice_closable is false. Ignored for other categories.

expected_row_version.description: The article's `row_version` as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.

version.description: The newest version, in status draft.

published_at.description: When the version takes effect; default now, earlier than now is 20001.

expected_row_version.description: The article's `row_version` as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.
The article's `row_version` as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.

store.description: Store key of specs/app-stores.yaml (that file comes with CT-19b).

min_supported_version.description: Null when no minimum is set for this platform and channel (no interception).

sections.description: Sections as stored in page_versions.sections (shape owned by the page schema).

ttl_sec.description:
How long the client may reuse this response, in seconds; the server constant 300 (the
example value of 03 §6.1, pending a write-back to the plan).

sections.description:
Only the sections whose condition matches and whose min_app_version this platform and
app version meet; the page shape is contracts/home-schema.json (sections:
`$defs/section`).

MarkMessagesReadRequest.description: Exactly one of message_ids (1–100 ids, duplicates counted once) or all=true.

marked_count.description: Messages this call turned from unread to read.

unread_count.description: Unread messages of the account left after the call.

service_push.description: Push of service messages (trades and withdrawals); the only switch shown in the MVP.

subscription_push.description: Push of subscription messages; reserved, not shown in the MVP.

marketing_push.description: Push of marketing messages; reserved, not shown in the MVP.

LedgerEntry.description: An available-subaccount entry, or the WITHDRAW_PAID summary entry of a paid withdrawal (BR-FUND-15).

balance_after_fen.description: Available balance after this entry (may be negative).
Always null; the summary entry does not change the available balance.

block_code.description: The error code that blocks a withdrawal now (contracts/error-codes.yaml), null when none.

quick_amounts_fen.description: Quick amount choices; empty when there are none.

masked_account.description: Masked snapshot of the payee account (BR-ID-33 细则).

reason_code.description: reject_reason_code or fail_code of a rejected or failed withdrawal (BR-TEXT-06).

fail_action.description: Action for account-type failures, e.g. change_payout_account (BR-TEXT-08).

Withdrawal.description: A withdrawal with channel_order_id (detail and create response).

masked_account.description: Masked snapshot of the payee account (BR-ID-33 细则).

reason_code.description: reject_reason_code or fail_code of a rejected or failed withdrawal (BR-TEXT-06).

fail_action.description: Action for account-type failures, e.g. change_payout_account (BR-TEXT-08).

channel_order_id.description: Channel serial number, only in PAID_API / PAID_MANUAL when recorded (BR-WDR-25 细则).

RiskInfo.description: Risk state for the ban / freeze explanation page (BR-ID-31, 拍板第二批 OPS-12).

reason_category.description: User-visible reason category (BR-ID-31); null when state=normal.

invite_code.description: Null when the user cannot invite.

inviter_bound.description: Only whether an inviter is bound, never who.

phone_bound.description: Whether a phone number is bound (BR-ID-01).

need_reconsent.description: The user must agree to the current legal version again (BR-ID-12).

PlatformPurchaseStatus.description:
Derived from convert.enabled.<platform> and convert.off_reason.<platform> (04 §10.1); lets
cards tell "maintenance" from "coming soon" before a tap. The tap result (50301
data.reason) still wins.

flags.description:
Client switches by key: agent.entry.visible, clipboard.enabled.<platform>,
home.fallback, h5.route.<page>.enabled, ui.grayscale (03 §4.3);
external_page.product_intercept (a platform product page inside the third-party page
container goes back to the native product detail) and external_page.union_host_block
(the container does not load union platform pages; derived from the server setting of
the same name; a client that cannot read it treats it as on) (BR-ATTR-29);
earnings.dashboard.visible (earnings dashboard entry, derived from
earnings.dashboard.enabled, BR-FUND-25).
Clipboard switches (BR-ID-16 细则「服务端开关」): clipboard.enabled.<platform> filters
recognition by e-commerce platform; clipboard.auto_read.<client> (client is ios, android
or harmony) turns off automatic clipboard reading on that client. A missing key counts
as on; these keys can only turn a feature off, never turn on what the user turned off.

search_status.description:
Search switch by platform code, derived from search.enabled.<platform> (04 §10.1);
how a client treats a missing platform is in BR-PROD-10 细则.

rank_platforms.description:
Platforms selectable on the hot list, derived by the server from the channel whitelist
in specs/material-channels.yaml (04 §6.3, 04 §10.1). Not a switch.

PlatformSearchStatus.description: Whether search is open for a platform (enum platform_search_status).

min_version.description: Below this version the user must agree again (BR-ID-12).

required.description: Must be false in the MVP (BR-INV-06).

backfill_hours.description: Window for entering an inviter later (BR-INV-07).

bind_phone_guide.description:
Show the bind-phone guide to new third-party accounts (BR-INV-03 细则). Optional in
the schema like every key added after v0.9; the server always sends it.

before_buy_tip.description: Show the inviter tip before the first purchase (BR-INV-21).

ConfigAgent.description: Agent availability and guest quota (04 §10.1; BR-AI-11, BR-AI-12).

ConfigH5Release.description: H5 version bucket for this caller (拍板第二批 TECH-28).

ConfigKf.description: WeCom customer-service chat link (chat entry only).

nav_host_sample_bp.description: Sampling rate of document-level navigation hosts, 1/10000 (default in BR-ATTR-29).

LinkPatternCategory.description: Category of a platform link pattern (enum link_pattern_category, BR-ATTR-29).

LinkPatternRule.description:
Hosts and path patterns of one platform and category. How hosts match (union_host by
registered domain including subdomains) and the path pattern syntax are defined with the
source table specs/link-patterns.yaml (CT-15g); concrete values come from real samples (B1-07).

ConfigLinkPatterns.description:
Client pre-filter subset of the platform link pattern table (source
specs/link-patterns.yaml). Clients decide where a document-level navigation in the
third-party page container goes (main frame, subframe, new window); product recognition
follows the server. When the fetch fails they use the last good version, then the bundled
snapshot, and never stop intercepting (BR-ATTR-29).

recheck_interval_sec.description:
On returning to the foreground, call GET /v1/app-versions/check again when the last
successful check is older than this (value and bundled default in BR-ID-01 细则
「最低支持版本的接口层拦截」).

HelpLinkTarget.description:
Jump target {route, params} of a help_links entry: always one help article, the Help
route of contracts/routes.json with its article_id (04 §10.1「原生页到帮助文章的入口表」).
conformance.ts checks that the route exists there and that params is a subset of that
route's params schema.

window_days.description:
Days within which an order claim may be filed, claim.window_hours rounded down to
days; null when below one day or not configured. Only renders the claim form's period
sentence (BR-ATTR-17 细则「找回页的填写指引」); claim.window_hours is not sent.

Config.description:
Top-level keys of /v1/config (04 §10.1, excerpt). Keys added after v0.9 (external_page,
link_patterns, external_hosts, app_update, help_links, claim, platform_icons,
lkg_max_age_sec, config_version, bridge_disabled_methods) are optional, so a client keeps reading an older last-good configuration (04 §5「兼容」); the
server always sends them, except that platform_icons lists only the marks with a published
replacement image (BR-TEXT-24). jump_tip, bridge_origins, auth_tips, compliance and display are not
shaped by 04 yet and stay free-form; the task that consumes each one types it
(bridge_origins with CT-03). clipboard is ConfigClipboard (only consent_version is typed).

external_hosts.description:
Third-party page hosts a deep link may open in ExternalPage, matched by full host name
(values and default in BR-ID-10 细则「深链能打开的第三方页面」); push and in-app
targets are not limited by it (03 §4.4).

help_links.description:
Native entries to help articles: key → jump target; an entry whose key is not
configured is not shown. Keys are defined by the rules that use them: price_compare
(BR-TEXT-03), claim_guide.<platform> (BR-ATTR-17 细则), login_help (BR-ID-02 细则),
withdraw_rules (BR-WDR-04 细则). Values are operations configuration (article ids).

lkg_max_age_sec.description: How long a last good configuration may be used, in seconds (02 §10, 03 §4.3); default 604800 (7 days).

config_version.description: Release version of this configuration, equal to the response ETag without quotes; saved together with the LKG (04 §10.1, 03 §4.7).

bridge_disabled_methods.description: Bridge methods disabled remotely; a call answers 90403 method_disabled (03 §5.3). Trial; default empty array.

ConfigPlatformIcon.description:
A replacement image published in the admin console for one platform mark (BR-TEXT-24).
Stored in the OSS media bucket under its content SHA-256 and cached long; each platform is
versioned on its own and a publish takes effect at once.

url.description:
Image address on the media domain (set by deployment, not fixed by the contract); the
file name is the content SHA-256.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the image content, the same digest as the file name.

version.description: Version of this platform's replacement image, counted per platform.

ConfigPlatformIcons.description: Platform mark replacement images (04 §10.1, BR-TEXT-24 细则): mark key → replacement image. Lists only the keys for which the admin console has published a replacement; a missing key (never replaced, or 「恢复内置」) means the client shows the image bundled in the package, and the object may be empty. Native clients download the image and check its SHA-256 before use, falling back to the bundled image on a mismatch; H5 loads it with `` and falls back to the bundled image on error. The accessible name is always the platform's Chinese name and never follows the image. The keys are enum platform_icon_key (PlatformIconKey, also the {key} of /admin/v1/platform-icons); new platforms add a key to both the same way.

Dict.description: The text dictionary (BR-TEXT-12); a key `<dict>.<code>` is items[dict][code].

version.description: Dictionary version, equal to data.dict_version of GET /v1/config; "0" before the first publish.

items.description: Texts by dict (the key's first segment), then by code (the rest of the key).

ProductCta.description:
Buy button chosen by the server; the client never decides it (BR-TEXT-12, 拍板第二批
TRADE-21): btn.buy.coupon (有券有返), btn.buy (无券有返 and amount_unknown),
btn.buy.no_rebate (无返利); other keys come with login_required and taolijin cards.

ProductTlj.description: Taolijin of the card, absent when there is none (BR-PRICE-08); never folded into prices.

ProductCard.description:
Product card (04 §8.3). Price semantics BR-PRICE-01 / 05; rebate_* and est_net_price_fen
are computed per request for the current caller and never cached (BR-PRICE-11). The card
carries a registered `link_id`; buying always goes through POST /v1/links/{link_id}/open
(BR-PRICE-12, BR-PRICE-21). amount_unknown cards have product_key, prices and rebate
null (BR-PRICE-08).

card_id.description: Agent card sequence id (c1, c2…), only on Agent cards (BR-AI-05).

product_key.description: Opaque product key (BR-PROD-02); null only on amount_unknown cards.

item_ref.description: Opaque signed reference passed through unchanged (BR-PROD-11).

shop_type.description: Shop type, e.g. tmall for Tmall shops on taobao.

no_rebate_cause.description:
May be non-null only when rebate_basis=no_rebate (BR-PRICE-08 细则「无返利原因」);
unknown values are treated as null. Not the open request's no_rebate_reason.

benefit_tags.description: Server-generated labels (有券, 预售, 标题显示为 X…); no per-card reasons.

is_presale.description: Presale; shown with the total price (BR-PRICE-22).

quoted_at.description: Receipt time of the union response the price is based on (BR-PRICE-11).

age_sec.description: Age of the price in seconds, computed by the server (BR-PRICE-11).

ad_label.description: Ad label (BR-TEXT-17); null on Agent relevance cards.

favorited.description:
Only on the product detail response (GET /v1/products/{product_key}): whether the
caller has favorited this product; false when not logged in (规划/01 F-PROD-12).

has_more.description: As reported by the union, not by the filtered page size (BR-PRICE-08).

fallback_items.description: Only when items is empty on the first page; the platform's first 10 feed items.

favorited_at.description: When the product was favorited (the original time for a repeated add).

InvalidFavoriteCard.description: Card of an invalid favorite; only the title and the image, no price and no rebate.

invalid.description:
true when fetching the card the union answered that the product does not exist, is
off shelf or cannot be promoted.

product_card.description:
invalid=false: the list card, same shape as a search card (ProductCard). invalid=true:
InvalidFavoriteCard, only the title and the image.

status.description: ok = points to draw; no_data = show price_trend.empty.

points.description: One point per day in date order; empty when status=no_data.

start_date.description: Date of the first record in the window; null when status=no_data.

source_key.description: Text key of the source line (price_trend.source.general for a product without coupon).

text.description:
Locally filtered clipboard or typed text (03 §4.6). Text outside links and tokens
is untrusted (BR-AI-05); prices in it are only material.claimed_price_fen.

scene.description:
Entry the text came from (subset of contracts/enums scene). Attribution-bearing
scenes (share, agent, …) cannot be chosen by the client: share links come only from
POST /v1/shares (phone level), Agent cards from the Agent service (BR-ATTR-05, 08).
share_ext is P1.

raw.description: The matched link or token as it appeared in the input.

ParseResult.description:
Result of one hit; exactly one of `card` and `error_code` is present. The oneOf branches
declare the property they require (strict Ajv2020, ADR-0001 §4.2 #15).

error_code.description: Error code for this hit (30131, 30132, 30141, 50301…), see error-codes.yaml.

installed.description: Default unknown; H5 always sends unknown (BR-ATTR-27 ①).

no_rebate_reason.description:
Only with no_rebate=true; default auth_declined. The server overrides it with
relation_conflict / binding_blocked when it decides so (BR-ID-18).

OpenLinkResult.description:
Response of open (04 §8.4). old_final_price_fen is the link's quoted_final_price_fen;
price_changed when |new − old| ≥ 100 fen or ≥ 5 % of old, both directions (BR-PRICE-13).
Prices and rebates are null on amount_unknown links, which are not re-checked. There is no
rebate_basis: no rebate is expressed by new_rebate_max_fen = 0 (BR-PRICE-08, BR-PRICE-13).

attempt_id.description:
Issued by the server for this open attempt: a new one for every open of a link, the
same one when the same Idempotency-Key is replayed. The client sends it in every
link_jump of this jump (BR-ATTR-21 细则「待跟单卡按实际外跳选」).

no_rebate_cause.description:
Non-null only when new_rebate_max_fen = 0 and the reason is known; unknown values are
treated as null. Not the request's no_rebate_reason (BR-ID-18).

new_link_id.description:
Set whenever the new price differs from the snapshot, or when a new link was
registered for the current user (BR-PRICE-12, BR-ATTR-05 ③); the client replaces the
card with it whether or not the user continues.

requote_failed.description:
Re-check failed: the user's cached link (≤ 900 s) is used, or, for a `no_rebate=true`
open, the no-rebate conversion or unpromoted product page (BR-PRICE-13).

ConvertLinkRequest.description:
Either product_key (with the tapped card's item_ref) or url; neither, or both, is 20001.
The oneOf branches declare the property they require (strict Ajv2020, ADR-0001 §4.2 #15).
A Taobao url is first resolved to an item_id and answered with a Baichuan open instruction
(JumpStep.sdk); the pasted link or token itself is never passed on (BR-PRICE-21).

scene.description:
Only the H5 entry (trade.convertAndOpen) uses convert (拍板第二批 TRADE-03); other
scenes are rejected with 20001 so that the client cannot pick an attribution scene
such as share (BR-ATTR-05, BR-ATTR-08).

installed.description: Default unknown; H5 always sends unknown (BR-ATTR-27 ①).

ConvertLinkData.description: The registered link_id plus the same fields as the open result (04 §6.3).

attempt_id.description:
Issued by the server for this open attempt: a new one for every open of a link, the
same one when the same Idempotency-Key is replayed. The client sends it in every
link_jump of this jump (BR-ATTR-21 细则「待跟单卡按实际外跳选」).

no_rebate_cause.description:
Non-null only when new_rebate_max_fen = 0 and the reason is known; unknown values are
treated as null. Not the request's no_rebate_reason (BR-ID-18).

LinkKind.description: Kind of a link on the in-app landing page (contracts/enums/trade.yaml link_kind).

SharedProductCard.description:
Product card subset of the share page and the in-app link landing page (04 §6.3): the
fields of ProductCard without rebate_min_fen, rebate_max_fen, rebate_basis,
no_rebate_cause and est_net_price_fen (no rebate amount is shown to the opener,
BR-PRICE-06, BR-ATTR-10), without cta (its key is derived from the rebate state), and
without the Agent-only card_id, match_tag and spec_text. quoted_at sits next to the card.

product_key.description: Opaque product key (BR-PROD-02); null only on amount_unknown cards.

item_ref.description: Opaque signed reference passed through unchanged (BR-PROD-11).

shop_type.description: Shop type, e.g. tmall for Tmall shops on taobao.

is_presale.description: Presale; shown with the total price (BR-PRICE-22).

age_sec.description: Age of the price in seconds, computed by the server (BR-PRICE-11).

quoted_at.description: Receipt time of the union response the price is based on (BR-PRICE-11).

viewer_is_sharer.description:
True only when called with a token whose user is the sharer of this share link; only
for the hint above the card (BR-ATTR-11). False for anonymous calls and other links.

quoted_at.description: Receipt time of the union response the price is based on (BR-PRICE-11).

jump_url.description: The sharer's converted short link used for the jump; never contains a token.

tpwd_ticket.description:
Short-lived ticket for POST /v1/share-pages/{link_id}/tpwd; null inside WeChat, without
User-Agent, or when the link has no token (BR-ATTR-10 细则).

open_in_app_url.description: LinkLanding deep link; null while share.open_in_app.enabled is off.

tpwd.description: The token of the share link, to be copied by the page.

EarningsPeriod.description: One period of the self or share column (BR-FUND-25).

paid_count.description: Paid child orders attributed to the user in the period (by paid_at).

est_fen.description: Estimated share of the user, by paid_at.

credited_fen.description: Signed sum of the credit entries by accounting_date; negative when the period has only reversals.

ReferralEarningsPeriod.description: One period of the referral column (BR-FUND-25); no count.

est_fen.description: Estimated direct and indirect referral share, by paid_at.

credited_fen.description: Signed sum of the REFERRAL_CREDIT entries by accounting_date.

EarningsColumn.description: Self or share column, four periods.

ReferralEarnings.description: Referral column, only this month and last month, all platforms.

as_of.description: Time the figures were computed (BR-FUND-25 细则).

AdminLoginTicket.description:
Intermediate credential of the admin login (BR-ID-34 细则「首次绑定身份验证器」): valid only for
the step it was issued for, sent in the request body, never an admin_token.

username.description: Account name (unique; a disabled account keeps its name, BR-ID-34).

new_password.description: Must differ from the initial password; composition rules are set by the server.

AdminTotpCode.description: Current 6-digit code of the authenticator, or of the SMS for the sms tier.

totp_secret.description: Base32 TOTP secret, shown for manual entry.

otpauth_uri.description: Key URI the console renders as the QR code.

admin_token.description: Sent in the Authorization header as a Bearer token (security scheme adminBearerAuth).

idle_timeout_sec.description: Seconds without activity after which the token stops working (BR-ID-34).

step_up_token.description: Sent as the `X-Step-Up-Token` header of the admin operation; records its tier.

AdminPermissionKey.description:
A value of contracts/enums/admin.yaml `admin_permission` (04 §11). Kept a string here so the
list lives in one place; clients ignore keys they do not know.

AdminPermissionGrant.description: A permission point of the account with its step-up annotation (04 §11 step-up column).

step_up_tier.description: Tier of every step-up operation of this point; null = none needs step-up.

step_up_operations.description: Operations of this point whose tier differs from step_up_tier.

username.description: Account name, also shown as the display name.

verify_phone_masked.description: Masked verify phone (BR-ID-33); null = none registered, sms tier unavailable.

permissions.description: Every point for a super admin, the ticked points otherwise; empty = no permission.

AdminDashboardTodoKey.description:
A to-do card of the workbench (enum admin_dashboard_todo_key; 01 F-ADM-26 ①). Each value
is shown only to accounts holding its permission point (see the enum).

AdminDashboardTodoBreakdown.description: One sub-count of a card (e.g. claim_review_pending auto_matched / manual_review).

key.description: Card-specific sub-key; clients ignore keys they do not know.

AdminDashboardTodo.description:
One to-do card. Present only when the account holds the card's permission point and the
card's module has shipped; then present with count 0 too.

count.description: Items waiting, equal to the pending count of the card's list page.

route.description: Console route the card opens, with its filter query.

oldest_at.description: Time of the earliest waiting item; null when count is 0.

breakdown.description: Sub-counts of the card; their sum equals count.

AdminDashboardYesterday.description: Yesterday's whole day, aggregated daily with the report rules (01 F-ADM-26 ②).

orders.description: Sub-orders with paid_at that day, not reduced by later invalidation.

AdminPayoutChannelCode.description: Payout channel (enum payout_method; the <channel> of payout.channel_paused.<channel>).

AdminDashboardStatus.description: System status cards; returned only with permission point fund.view.

payout_channel_paused.description: Channels whose payout.channel_paused.<channel> is on; empty when none.

balance_w_expired.description: Whether the enterprise Alipay balance W is expired (BR-WDR-18); null until W entry ships.

todo.description: To-do cards the account may see, in enum order.

AdminAccount.description: Read-only view of an admin account; no password, hash, TOTP secret or full phone.

totp_bound.description: false = the next login goes through the first binding.

locked_until.description: End of the current login lock; null when not locked.

permissions.description: Ticked points (admin_permissions); empty for a super admin, who has every point.

PlatformIconKey.description:
Platform mark key (enum platform_icon_key, BR-TEXT-24 细则标识键表); the keys of /v1/config
`platform_icons` (ConfigPlatformIcons) are the same list.

AdminPlatformIconFormat.description: Format of a cleaned platform mark file.

AdminPlatformIconSha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the cleaned file, the same digest as its file name.

AdminPlatformIconUrl.description: Cleaned file on the media domain (set by deployment), named by its SHA-256; shown only as an image (``), never inlined into the page.

AdminPlatformIconSourceUrl.description: Official brand or asset download page the file was taken from (BR-TEXT-24 细则「必填登记」).

AdminPlatformIconVersion.description: One saved version of a platform mark (BR-TEXT-24).

version.description: Counted per mark from 1; the same number /v1/config sends once published.

sanitized.description: true = the cleaned file differs from the uploaded original.

downloaded_on.description: Date the file was downloaded from the source page; null = not registered.

publishable.description: true = both source_url and downloaded_on are registered; false = draft.

ever_published.description: true = published at least once; its registration can no longer be changed.

revision.description:
1 when saved, plus 1 on every registration change (PATCH .../versions/{version}); the
CAS value of that PATCH.

created_by.description: Username of the admin who saved the version.

AdminPlatformIcon.description: A platform mark and its published version (null = built-in image).

current_version.description: Published version; null = the client shows the bundled image.

revision.description:
0 until the first publish; plus 1 on every publish, rollback and restore-builtin, never
going back (saving or registering a version does not change it). The CAS value of
publish and restore-builtin, so a retried old request cannot undo a later change.

latest_version.description: Newest saved version, drafts included; null = nothing saved yet.

updated_by.description: Username of the admin who last saved, published, rolled back or restored; null = never changed.

items.description: Every key of enum platform_icon_key once, in enum order.

AdminPlatformIconUploadRequest.description: multipart/form-data body of a platform mark upload; one part `file`.

file.description: The SVG or PNG file as uploaded (BR-TEXT-24 细则「上传与发布」).

AdminPlatformIconUpload.description:
The cleaned file of an upload, not yet a version. Saved with POST
/admin/v1/platform-icons/{key}/versions until `expires_at`.

sanitized.description:
true = the cleaned file differs from the original: the console shows 「已清除不安全内容」
and saving needs sanitized_confirmed=true.

sanitized_confirmed.description:
The operator confirmed the cleaned preview; absent means false. Must be true when the
upload has sanitized=true.

AdminPlatformIconSourceRequest.description: The version's revision as shown plus at least one of the two registrations.

expected_revision.description: The version's `revision` as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.

version.description: Version to publish; older than the current one = rollback.

expected_revision.description: The mark's `revision` as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.
